# Campervan and motorhome hire at Bunk Campers

Established in 2007, Bunk Campers are one of the UK & Ireland’s leading campervan and motorhome hire companies.

We’re all about driving adventure, so rest assured you will receive a modern, clean and well maintained campervan or motorhome. All of our vehicles for hire offer practical style and comfort, whether you are enjoying a short family holiday or a longer road trip.

Enjoy the freedom and flexibility to explore the UK & Ireland at your own pace, wake up to the best views, stop, shop and cook along the way.

For [**campervan & motorhome hire in Scotland**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/), our depot is located 10 minutes from **Edinburgh** airport and 50 minutes from Glasgow International Airport.

For [**Ireland campervan hire**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/), we are the only company with depots in both [**Dublin**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/) & [**Belfast**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/).

Offering easy access to **[England](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/),** we have a motorhome rental depot in Greater [**London**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/) offering an excellent starting point for an English motorhome adventure.

## Edinburgh

# Edinburgh Campervan & Motorhome Hire

The Bunk Campers Edinburgh depot is located just 10 minutes from [Edinburgh International Airport](https://www.edinburghairport.com/) making it easy and convenient to collect your Bunk Campers motorhome before exploring the beautiful country of Scotland.

Edinburgh is a city filled with epic views, histroic castle and medieval streets. Our Edinburgh depot is the perfect starting point to your Scotland motorhome holiday. From the Scottish Highalnds, to must-see tourist attractions, hidden-gems, music events, and more, you can make the adventure your own. Get your hiking boots on and climb Ben Nevis, look for the infamous mythical creature in Loch Ness, take in the beauty of the North Coast 500 or visit the Isle of Skye.

Choose from a range of 2-6 berth motorhomes and find the one that suits you best. Our friendly Edinburgh depot team welcome thousands of national and international travellers every year and they can’t wait to welcome you next. When you arrive, our team will give you a full vehicle demo ahead of your road trip.

## How to book your Edinburgh motorhome holiday

Book your Edinburgh motorhome holiday directly on our website using the live booking bar. Get live availability by selecting your travel dates, pick your campervan and book!

If you prefer to contact our team directly to book you can email us at bunkcampers@enquries.com or call us on [0800 059 0905](https://www.google.co.uk/search?q=bunk+campers+belfast&sca_esv=60df094e8c3a7fc5&source=hp&ei=CjrOZeS9MP6nhbIP-LmNmAk&iflsig=ANes7DEAAAAAZc5IGv4OP7qE_ikpNIxSjQnOwne99KNt&ved=0ahUKEwjk6pyp4K2EAxX-U0EAHfhcA5MQ4dUDCBA&uact=5&oq=bunk+campers+belfast&gs_&sclient=gws-wiz#).

From the family-friendly motorhomes to compact campervans, we have the perfect vehicle to suit your taste and budget. With a range of [2-6 berth motorhomes,](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/)  all our vehicles come equipped with everything you need to enjoy your motorhome holiday, including kitchen equipment and gas. We also have a range of hirable extras including bedding and towels.

**Not sure what motorhome to choose? No problem, our team are ready to help- [contact us](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) and a member of our team will assist with a personalised quote.**

## Planning your Scotland motorhome holiday from our Edinburgh depot

Our Edinburgh depot is closely located 10 minutes from Edinburgh International Airport. We have limited onsite parking available if you’re arriving by car, simply add this as an extra when you’re booking or get in touch with [enquiries@bunkcampers.com](mailto:enquiries@bunkcampers.com)

You can also get the X18 Whitburn train from St Andrew’s House to Dunnet Way, leaving you with just a short 2-minute walk to the depot.

If you want to immediately get started with your road trip, you can head north to the iconic Eilean Donan Castle, explore Glencoe valley, or visit the infamous Glenfinnan Viaduct from Harry Potter! We recommend planning or pre-booking campsites prior to your trip to ensure you have somewhere to park for the night on your trip. Learn more about our [camping advice](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/campsite-guide/).

- [**How old to I need to be to hire a campervan in Scotland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/#)


Drivers can be aged 21-80 years old to hire a campervan in the Scotland with Bunk Campers, and all our rentals include fully comprehensive insurance for the driver(s). Please note, that we are unable to hire to undergraduates and/or students under 25 years of age.

- [**Can I bring a pet?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/#)


Yes – we offer pet friendly holidays! [Click here to learn more](https://bunkcampers.com/pet-friendly-campervan-hire/).

- [**What’s included in the rental price?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/#)


Insurance cover for one driver, unlimited mileage, kitchen box including kettle, 24-hour roadside assistance, water hose and hook-up cable

- [**How much is it to hire a campervan from Edinburgh?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/#)


Campervan hire prices vary depending on multiple factors, including your chosen dates and vehicle choice. You can use the booking bar at the top of the page for an instant quote.

# Being Green

## It’s not easy being green!

#### We are targeting a reduction in wasted energy and resources.

### Euro 5+ Engines.

We invest in having the most fuel efficient fleet. All of our campervans for hire in the UK & Ireland are less than 3 years old – we don’t rent old bangers!

Bunk Campers continual investment in bringing you the most modern, freshest and fuel efficient fleet mean that we are the only campervan and motorhome rental company in Ireland to offer you EURO 6 ENGINES. We make your travel budget go miles further with our modern fleet + lower fuel consumption, saving you money.

### What are the benefits?

Bunk’s 2 / 4 / 6 person campervans feature the new, more powerful Fiat Ducato Euro 5 engine with advanced diesel technology. This means:

- Greater performance – a better holiday.
- Lower fuel consumption – saving you money.
- Lower emissions – better for the environment.
- Smoother running and quieter ride – a better drive.

Fiat have completely reworked the engine line-up on the Fiat Ducato model. Rent one of our Aero / Vista or Grande campervans and you will be travelling in one of Europe’s most modern vehicles.

#### **Cleaning our fleet**

Where possible we harvest rainwater at our depots and use this to clean the outside of our campervans. We are continuing to invest in harvesting facilities at our depots.

#### **Low energy cycles**

Our bedding kits are freshly laundered on 30 degree washing cycles. Washing at 30 degrees saves energy.

### Minimum Fill Levels

#### **Water**

We don’t believe in filling your campervan water tanks to full capacity for your arrival. This reduces waste of water that is not used and reduces your fuel consumption as you are not carrying extra and unnecessary weight. Every van is filled with water to a quarter of its capacity so that you have enough to get started for the first few days of your trip.

#### **Green Toilet Fluid**

We have managed to source an environmentally friendly WC fluid suitable for campervan and Motorhome toilets. Blue bio is a 2 in 1 waste and flush tank additive that works at 1% dilution which is easy and safe to use. We are the exclusive retailers of this in Ireland and the only campervan hire company in the UK to use it.

### What You Can Do

#### **Disposal**

Disposal of your grey and black waste water is your responsibility. Use campsites facilities so you can dispose of your waste water frequently and responsibly.

#### **Manage your waste**

Campervans have only limited facilities for storing food therefore you really only need to shop as you go and minimise waste of fresh food. Recycling facilities for bottles, newspapers, aluminium cans etc are widely available across the country so you can dump as you go on your travels.

#### **Leave no trace**

Avoid damaging animal habitats, use small amounts of soap for washing, always pick up litter and leave your site as you found it.

# **Wild Camping in the UK and Ireland**

![Wild Camping in the UK & Ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/DSC_9828-1024x684.jpg)

### What is Wild Camping?

Wild camping is an overnight stay, not on a campsite.

### Is it legal?

**For campervans and motorhomes, Wild Camping is not permitted across the UK & Ireland.** In many parts, it is tolerated provided a common sense approach is taken and leave no trace principles are followed. There is always the risk of being moved on – especially if it is considered that you are causing an obstruction.

Remember, there is now a vast array of campsites with picturesque locations across the UK and Ireland, we encourage all guests to motorhome responsibly by using these first before you consider wild camping in a campervan or motorhome. These sites are geared up for motorhomes, have all the required facilities to power up your vehicle, as well as having a warm welcome and the ability to offer great local advice to visitors. Not to mention that if you’re staying locally on a campsite you’re contributing much-needed income to the local economy!

### **Scotland**

There is widespread misinformation on wild camping in Scotland, particularly due to the long tradition of freedom to roam formalised in the [Land Reform (Scotland) Act, 2003](http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2003/2/pdfs/asp_20030002_en.pdf). The Land Reform Act permits wild camping on most enclosed land (provided you follow the Scottish Outdoor Access Code/Leave no trace policy)– but it **excludes motorised vehicles and therefore does not apply to campervans or motorhomes.**

Wild camping in motorhomes/campervans has been tolerated in some remoter parts of Scotland away from settlements but unfortunately, the significant growth in popularity of motorhome holidays – especially on the NC500 – has created issues in particular hotspots due to the effect on the environment and overall infrastructure. If public or private land owners restrict or regulate parking on their land, you must comply with this.

Certain Scottish islands (such as Colonsay and Tiree) now don’t allow campervans or motorhomes at all since they lack the infrastructure to accommodate vehicles of that size.

Loch Lomond is subject to Wild Camping Byelaws throughout the National Park between March and September in order to protect the loch shores meaning that camping is only permitted in certain areas.

We recommend making use of the wonderful campsites located throughout Scotland where possible and at all times, minimise your impact by following the **[Highway Code](https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.proofpoint.com%2Fv2%2Furl%3Fu%3Dhttps-3A__www.highwaycodeuk.co.uk_parking-2Dat-2Dnight.html%26d%3DDwMFaQ%26c%3DeuGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM%26r%3Dgc-mWqXeiZIGKQFgaEcIoL6JsxNxed1k8PepqQrvZOZ5quAHpE6uDcDKzULW_cqL%26m%3DEZPhonK8v_XSrMNHIiEqNry-RGHIoN325ZdM0RFhZs4%26s%3DA4VLrCqWxZG5WCnBmLWKqmDF0fOZUDGTeemtQsT3o4w%26e%3D&data=04%7C01%7CLeanne.Cromie%40Bunkcampers.com%7C5a425f34ba984f3c438508d9062df506%7C21de7db0f6844d47897fd8dcd46773bb%7C0%7C1%7C637547616728524036%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C2000&sdata=5WHAM6vVCYjKTYUpCKDDsVSUGTYM0ahenAWmP5zKSJU%3D&reserved=0)** and the guidance in the **[Scottish Outdoor Access Code](https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.outdooraccess-scotland.scot%2F&data=04%7C01%7CLeanne.Cromie%40Bunkcampers.com%7C5a425f34ba984f3c438508d9062df506%7C21de7db0f6844d47897fd8dcd46773bb%7C0%7C1%7C637547616728533992%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C2000&sdata=U59dVDpAxwN%2Bdb0a4NpcvNPpwaLCB45L4a2tQa4MymM%3D&reserved=0)**, including the specific advice on **[car parking](https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.outdooraccess-scotland.scot%2Fpractical-guide-all%2Fout-and-about%2Fcar-parking&data=04%7C01%7CLeanne.Cromie%40Bunkcampers.com%7C5a425f34ba984f3c438508d9062df506%7C21de7db0f6844d47897fd8dcd46773bb%7C0%7C1%7C637547616728533992%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C2000&sdata=J1T2NDiUFBpYJwoT64Gvub9iOeb7GhK12wu4%2Fm7721s%3D&reserved=0)**. Respect the interests of others, care for the environment and take responsibility for your own actions.

### **England & Wales**

Wild camping is only legal in England and Wales if you have been granted permission by the landowner and every bit of land is owned by a private individual.

The National Parks Authority forbid wild camping within any National Parks of England and Wales.

### **Northern Ireland**

Wild camping is only legal in Northern Ireland if you have been granted permission by the landowner and every bit of land is owned by a private individual.

Northern Ireland Forestry Service issues camping permits at some of its sites.

### **Ireland**

Wild camping in Ireland is not permitted. The rule of thumb is to move on if asked to and follow the **[Leave No Trace](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/leave-no-trace/)** guidelines.

### Wild Camping Guidelines – Leave no trace

Anyone camping in the wild should follow the Scottish Outdoor Access Code or the Leave No Trace policy:

- Avoid overcrowding by moving on to another location if it’s already a busy spot.
- Be discrete, try to camp out of sight and away from houses or farms.
- Do not camp in enclosed fields of crops or farm animals
- Park up late and leave early.
- Do not drink alcohol to ensure you can drive away at a moments notice
- Be prepared to move on if asked, always be friendly and polite.
- Choose your toilet carefully – away from open water.
- Use a stove or leave no trace of any camp fire. Never cut down or damage trees.
- Keep groups small and quiet, and enjoy the peace and the scenery.
- Always pick up any litter and leave the area as you found it.
- If in doubt, ask the landowner. Their advice just might help you find a better camping spot.

[**Find out more**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/leave-no-trace/)

### Is Wild Camping Safe?

Wild camping, if done correctly is safe. Just be sure to take the usual precautions. Always let someone know where you are, what you are doing and when you will return. If you don’t feel safe or sure about procedures, or if you prefer to have a shower and toilet, then perhaps wild camping isn’t for you; **head to a campsite instead.**

### Wild Camping Alternatives!

![Wild Camping in the UK & Ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/DSC06386-1024x683.jpg)

**UK**

Bunk Campers are part of **The Camping & Caravanning Club** **Privilege Scheme** meaning that when you hire a campervan or motorhome from us, you will receive up to **30% off campsite fees.** Many of these campsites are in idyllic locations including the Highlands, Islands, Cotswolds, Lake District and North York Moors.  [**Find out more about the participating campsites and how to book by visiting their website and enjoy 30% off!**](https://bunkcampers.com/enjoy-camping-caravanning-club-member-benefits-with-you-hire-with-bunk-campers/)

**Ireland**

When you hire a campervan in Ireland from Bunk Campers, you will be given temporary membership to [**Safe Nights Ireland**](http://www.safenightsireland.com/) who offer a large network of safe overnight parking locations across Ireland. From country houses, open farms, national parks to pub locations – you really can get off the beaten track! Customers can then stay at any of Safe Nights Ireland site for a small fee, much cheaper than a campsite and make use of the site facilities.

Alternatively, take a look at **[Camping Ireland](https://www.campingireland.ie/)** a Tourism Ireland approved range of Camp Sites, giving you peace of mind for user-tested campsites. They also offer a host of campsites that are open all year round, perfect for winter road trips.

## Planning for your campervan hire UK & Ireland holiday

Deciding what you will do and which regions to discover on your campervan hire holiday is an exciting experience! However, there are other things to take into consideration when hiring a campervan. Things can be a little overwhelming before you arrive, especially if it’s your first motorhome holiday. What road trips should I do? What do I want to see? What do I want to do? What do I need to bring? Where shall I go? Well don’t worry – Bunk Campers have you covered.

We’ve outlined some useful information before your arrival on your campervan holiday including what to pack, hireable extras and ferry crossings.

### Driver Eligibility & Restrictions

Important driving licence criteria, driving restrictions and mainland European travel information.

**[Read more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/licences-and-restrictions/)**

### Understanding the Security Deposit & Liability Options

Essential information on your security deposit for your campervan hire.

**[Read more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/security-deposit-protection-options/ "Campervan Hire UK & Ireland Insurance")**

### What’s Included in your Camper?

A full inventory of everything that comes with your rental.

**[View inventory](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/motorhome-hire-inventory/ "Campervan Hire UK & Ireland Insurance")**

### Optional Extras

Need something extra? From bedding, child seats, and camping furniture, we have everything you need to get you on the road.

**[View Extras](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hireable-extras/ "Campervan hire UK & Ireland Extras")**

### Getting to Bunk Campers

Discover the easiest way to get to our depots.

[**Find out more**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/getting-to-bunk-campers/)

### FAQs

Get answers to the most frequently asked questions about campervan hire in the UK and Ireland with Bunk Campers.

[**View FAQs**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/faqs/)

### On the Road Support

For help and troubleshooting on the road including accident procedures, breakdown assistance and how to videos, please visit our Help Centre.

[**Visit Help Centre**](https://help.justgo.uk.com/)

### Hassle-Free Returns

We’ve added some hassle-free return options that mean it has never been easier to return your motorhome.

[Find out more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hassle-free-returns/ "Campervan hire UK & Ireland Extras")

### Discount on Ferry Crossings with Campervans

Enjoy discount on ferry crossings in your campervan with Bunk Campers. Find out how to book and save.

**[Read more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/ferry-crossings/ "Campervan Hire UK & Ireland Ferry Crossings")**

Not sure what to pack? Find out here with our campervan holiday checklist!

# Security Deposits, Liability Reduction Options & Additional Drivers

![Security Deposits & Additional Drivers Hero Image](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/security-deposits-Additional-Drivers.jpg)

At Bunk Campers, (as with most hire companies), we require a security deposit for the purposes set out in our [**Terms and Conditions**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/terms/). The amount for the security deposit will be pre-authorised from your credit or debit card at check-in.

You are required to have the funds available in your account at check-in to cover the security deposit. **The vehicle cannot be released until the funds are pre-authorised.** The security deposit is authorised in the currency of your pick up depot.

## Liability Reduction Options

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bunkcampers2025lrodualcurrency-1024x348.jpg)

Guests can choose if they wish to continue with the standard security deposit or to increase their level of cover. We recommend that all guests are comfortable with their liability in the event of damage. The nightly charge payable for any of our Liability Reduction options is based on the number of nights of hire for the minimum rental period. The maximum nightly charge for any of our Liability Reduction options is 15 nights per rental segment.

* * *

## What is a motorhome hire security deposit & what am I protected for?

The security deposit covers the cost of any loss or damage from any one incident that has occurred to the vehicle whilst it has been on hire. It is authorised at check-in and will be released providing your vehicle is returned in the condition it was received in. At Bunk Campers, security deposits are authorised in the currency of the hire depot.

In the event of any loss or damage, the hirer is liable for up to the value of this amount. The security deposit is used to fund:

- Any loss or damage to equipment, fixtures, fittings, windows, tyres or negligent damage to the vehicle.
- Any road traffic violation administration fees.
- Any cleaning fees.
- Any refuelling costs.
- Any late return fees.

Guests should allow up to 28 days for the security deposit to be released back into their account.

In the event of an insurance claim, regardless of fault, the security deposit will be retained until the insurers have settled the claim. Please note, this can be a lengthy process and is out of Bunk Campers’ control.

**Please note:**

- The security deposit does not cover the below items. In the event of damage, guests are liable for the full cost of repair.
- Damage to any part of the vehicle over 6ft/182cm from the ground.
- Damage to the underside of the vehicle.
- Damage caused to windscreen, mirrors and/or tyres (unless windscreen, mirror and tyre protection is included).
- Liability applies to the first incident only.
- Windscreen, mirror, and tyre protection is limited to replacement or repair of one windscreen, two mirrors or two tyres, after which normal replacement costs will be payable.

This information is a summary only. Please refer to our terms and conditions for full details.

* * *

## Additional Drivers – Share the Driving Seat!

Having an additional driver can ease the pressure on the main driver. Share the driving, share the responsibility and take your time to enjoy the open road. With an additional driver you can;

- Take fewer breaks – Get to your destination faster!
- Travel further – See more of the land!
- Share the experience of the open road!

**You can add up to three additional drivers to your trip.**

* * *

## Booking Additional Protection & Drivers

All additional protection options and additional drivers can be added at the time of booking, during online check-in or when you come to collect your campervan. Please note, all additional drivers must be present at the depot for collection and must bring identification and documentation as required and outlined in [**Driver Eligibility & Restrictions**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/licences-and-restrictions/).

For more information or to add additional protection to your booking, please [**contact our team**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/)

# Why Bunk Campers?

At Bunk Campers, all of our campervans are converted, fitted and kitted to our own exacting specifications based on our experiences. Established in 2007, award-winning Bunk Campers has grown to be one of the largest campervan hire and motorhome rental companies in the UK & Ireland with a fleet that is 100% company-owned.

Bunk Campers motorhome hire is the perfect way to explore the great outdoors with all the comforts of home. All our campervans are modern, stylish and packed with all the features you need for a comfortable journey. Our motorhomes are new and well-equipped, with everything you need for a comfortable journey. We offer a wide range of motorhomes to suit all budgets and group sizes. Along with our team of experienced and friendly staff who are always on hand to help, as well as offering flexible rental periods to suit your needs.

# Bunk Campers Mission and Values

### Mission statement

We believe that travel is what you make it, that you decide when and where and that we are here to help to get you there. Our mission is to be the first choice for campervan hire and motorhome rental in the UK & Ireland.

We use the following principles to drive our business:

### **Our Campervans**

Freedom is functional. We provide bright, modern accommodation on wheels from both the leading manufacturers and our own manufacturing facility. Nobody knows campers like Bunk Campers.

### **Our Customers**

Travel is our business and we have customers from all over the globe. You will always get a response from a name not a number. We are personal because independence should not mean that you are on your own.

### **Our Service**

You will get the same high quality of customer service wherever you are in the Bunk World. We commit time to your rental. Your vehicle will be checked and prepped by trained staff and you will receive a full and comprehensive demonstration before you begin your road trip. When you are ready, we hand over the keys.

### **Our Performance**

It’s all about keeping you on the open road. If there is a problem we have a solution. We take pride in our performance and publish statistics at all our locations. Your feedback makes us better.

### **Our Community**

We are social. We encourage our customers to share experiences with Bunk and with each other. We believe that the bigger our community the better the journey. Take time, join in.

## Ireland

# Ireland Campervan & Motorhome Hire

Do you dream of touring Ireland? Hire a campervan or motorhome and discover the Emerald Isle on a holiday like no other! Explore this wonderful country from top to bottom and at your own pace in a motorhome. Pick up your campervan rental from our [**Dublin**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/) or [**Belfast**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/) depot and embark on a journey to unmissable destinations including Clare, Cork, Galway and Donegal. Or head into Dublin city centre for a tour of the Guinness Storehouse, watch Riverdance the play or visit the wonderful Temple Bar area.

The Wild Atlantic Way, one of the longest defined coastal routes in the world at 2,500km in length, needs all the time you can give it. Kiss the Blarney Stone in Cork, surf some waves at Bundoran beach in Donegal or visit Malin Head, the most northerly point of Ireland. This unmissable route is a must-see when you visit Ireland.

The country of Ireland is filled with jaw-dropping landscapes, stunningly beautiful scenic road trips and of course Guinness and Whiskey. Recently voted as one of the 20 most beautiful countries in the world’s [**20 most beautiful countries by Rough Guide readers**](https://theculturetrip.com/europe/ireland/articles/16-reasons-why-you-should-visit-ireland-at-least-once-in-your-lifetime/), the Isle of Arran, Cliffs of Moher and Dingle are all unmissable stops along the infamous Wild Atlantic Way road trip.

###### Wild Atlantic Way



Ireland’s most infamous driving route, stretching through nine counties. [Explore everything Ireland has to offer along this glorious route](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/trip-ideas/ireland/campervan-hire-ireland-wild-atlantic-way/) with Ireland campervan rental.

- ![ireland motorhome hire](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/dublin.jpg)



###### Temple Bar



Lively pubs, cobbled streets, live folk music, and great pints of Guinness. Temple bar is a must-see in Dublin.

- ![ireland camper hire](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/dingle.jpg)



###### Dingle Peninsula



Stunning scenery, rugged cliffs, sandy beaches and rolling hills. Dingle Peninsula is the perfect stop on any Irish motorhome road trip.

- ![motorhome hire ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/aran-islands.jpg)



###### Aran Islands



Three islands off the coast of the west of Ireland. Wild landscapes, famous knitted jumpers and islands full of culture and heritage.

- ![ireland motorhome rental](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/ring-of-kerry.jpg)



###### Ring of Kerry



Glorious stretches of white sand beaches, striking coastal landscapes and rural seaside towns.

- ![ireland camper rental](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/wicklow.jpg)



###### Wicklow Mountains



Ireland’s largest national park is unmissable. Ideal for your Ireland motorhome hire road trip!


- ![Guinness Storehouse](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/guinness.jpg)



###### Guinness Storehouse



Visit the home of Guinness at St. James’s Gate and learn about how this famous Irish drink is made – you can even pour your own!

- ![Soda bread](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/soda-bread.jpg)



###### Soda Bread



Traditional Irish bread made of flour, baking soda, salt and buttermilk. Best served covered in butter…

- ![Irish stew](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/irish-stew.jpg)



###### Irish Stew



Made from root vegetables and usually either lamb or beef. Ideal on a chilly day to help warm up in your campervan hire.

- ![Wheaten bread](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/wheaten-bread.jpg)



###### Wheaten Bread



Sweeter and richer than soda bread, wheaten bread makes the perfect side to some Irish stew.

- ![Irish champ](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/champ.jpg)



###### Champ



Creamy mashed potatoes with scallions, butter and milk. A sure hit on your motorhome hire adventure.


- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-4.jpg)



###### Eagle Point Camping



Eagle Point Camping and Caravan accommodation overlooking Bantry Bay, West Cork, in South West Ireland. Perfect for touring the West Cork region.

- ![Clifden ECO Camping](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/clifden-eco-campsite.jpg)



###### Clifden ECO Camping



Clifden ECO Campsite, Multi-Award Winning, CO2 Neutral, Listed Geosite. Natural beauty, sandy beaches, breathtaking sunsets and cosy campfires in Connemara, this campsite has it all.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-2.jpg)



###### Portsalon Luxury Camping



Portsalon Luxury Camping is located in a stunning coastal setting in the North of Donegal. The ideal starting location for beginning your Wild Atlantic Way road trip.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-3.jpg)



###### Rosguill Holiday Park



Rosguill Park is a Caravan and Camping Holiday park with beach view sites, suitable for campervans, motorhomes and tents.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-5.jpg)



###### Mannix Point Camping



A great location on the Ring of Kerry. The waterside location is quiet and peaceful with beautiful views.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-6.jpg)



###### Wave Crest Camping



Situated on the west side of the beautiful Isle of Barra, with prime views of the Atlantic, Wavecrest is an ideal location to pitch or park your motorhome.

- ![Connemara national park](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Connemara.jpg)



###### Connemara National Park



Walking trails, beautiful scenery and visitor exhbitions at the National Park Visitor Centre. Could you ask for much more on your campervan rental road trip?

- ![Croke Park](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/croke-park.jpg)



###### Croke Park



Gaelic games stadium in Dublin, often referred to as ‘Croker’ by GAA fans. This is the principal national stadium of Ireland.

- ![Murder Hole Beach](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/murder-hole-beach.jpg)



###### Murder Hole Beach



A remote, hidden and beautiful beach in County Donegal. The drive is both winding and stunning at the same time – try not to get too distracted with the views in your motorhome hire!

- ![Kinsale](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/kinsale.jpg)



###### Kinsale



Stunning landscapes, rich heritage and colourful streets. Known as ‘The Gourmet Capital of Ireland’, there is plenty of delicious food to eat.


- ![Guinness Storehouse Tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/guinness-tour.jpg)



###### Guinness Storehouse Tour



The full brewery experience is all about Ireland’s most famous beer. Includes a rooftop bar, tastings and the chance to pour your own pint.

- ![Blarney Castle Day Tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/blarney-castle-tour.jpg)



###### Blarney Castle Day Tour



The home of the Blarney Stone is filled with rich history and culture.

- ![Cliffs of Moher Tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/cliffs-of-moher.jpg)



###### Cliffs of Moher Tour



Undoubtedly one of Ireland’s most stunning natural attractions. 700ft cliffs of wild limestone for you to explore.


- ![Wicklow Mountains](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/wicklow-mountains.jpg)



###### Wicklow Mountains



The largest continuous upland area in Ireland. A picturesque destination for your Irish campervan hire journey.

- ![Kilmainham Gaol](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Kilmainham-Gaol.jpg)



###### Kilmainham Gaol



Previously a prison in Dublin and is now a museum. Many Irish revolutionaries, including the leaders of the 1916 Easter Rising, were imprisoned and executed here by the UK Government. A must-see historical sight.

- ![bundoran](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/bundoran.jpg)



###### Bundoran



Known as one of the best surfing spots in Ireland, perfect for beginners or advanced surfers to catch some waves in your Ireland motorhome rental.

- ![blarney stone](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/blarney-stone.jpg)



###### Blarney Stone



The Blarney Stone is built into the battlements of Blarney Castle. Legend has it that kissing the stone endows the kisser with the gift of the gab.

- ![Croagh Patrick](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Croagh-Patrick.jpg)



###### Croagh Patrick



Nicknamed ‘the Reek’, Croagh Patrick is famed for its Patrician Pilgrimage in honour of Saint Patrick, Ireland’s patron saint.


- ![wild Atlantic way](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/WAW-1.jpg)



###### Wild Atlantic Way



Secluded beaches, breathtaking sunsets over dramatic Atlantic waves, stunning headlands, 4 seasons in a day and a surplus of sheep. [This is Ireland in all its glory, ideal for your Irish campervan hire route.](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/trip-ideas/ireland/campervan-hire-ireland-wild-atlantic-way/)

- ![ring of kerry](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/ring-of-kerry-road-trip.jpg)



###### Ring of Kerry



A 180km scenic route around County Kerry. Filled with plenty of rugged and verdant coastal landscapes and rural seaside villages.

- ![Ancient East](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/ancient-east.jpg)



###### Ireland's Ancient East



[Ireland’s Ancient East](https://bunkcampers.com/irelands-ancient-east-by-campervan/) encompasses County Cavan, Longford, Louth, Meath, Monaghan and Westmeath. Where vibrant history and heritage meet modern life. Perfect for hitting the open road in your campervan hire.

**Ireland Motorhome Hire FAQ’s**

- [**What licence do I need to drive a motorhome in Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/#)


At Bunk Campers, all of our campervans and motorhomes for hire in Ireland are under 3500kg so can be driven with a normal ‘B’ car driving licence.

- [**How much is it to rent a campervan in Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/#)


The cost of campervan hire in Ireland will vary depending on the season, pick up location, and vehicle type. Our prices are lower in the off season (Nov-March) with July and August being the most expensive time to hire a campervan in Ireland.



To check availability and pricing, use the quote and book button on our website, email [enquiries@bunkcampers.com](mailto:enquiries@bunkcampers.com) or call us to speak to our team.

- [**Where can I hire a motorhome in Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/#)


Bunk Campers are the only campervan and motorhome hire company in Ireland with depots in both Dublin and Belfast. Our Dublin depot is conveniently located close to Dublin airport. Our Belfast depot is south of the city centre in Carryduff making it easy and convenient to get on the open road.



We also offer one-way rentals across Ireland meaning you can collect your campervan or motorhome from Bunk Campers depot in Dublin and drop off in Belfast, or vice-versa. You can book a one-way rental in Ireland directly on our website.

- [**How old do I need to be to hire a campervan in Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/#)


Drivers can be aged **21-79 years old** to hire a campervan in Ireland with Bunk Campers, provided they meet the usual driving licence criteria outlined in our terms and conditions. All of our rentals include fully comprehensive insurance for the driver(s).



Visit our [driver eligibility page](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/licences-and-restrictions/) for information on important driving criteria to know before you get out on the road.

- [**Can you park a motorhome anywhere in Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/#)


Parking up for the night on the side of the road or in fields, sometimes known as wild camping, **is not permitted in Ireland and Northern Ireland.** There are designated areas such as campsites or low-cost alternatives for overnight stays.



You should be able to park in most shopping centres, service stops and farms for short-term parking on trips & visits to the shop. Read our [**Camping Guide**](https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbunk-campers-uk.flywheelsites.com%2Fen%2Fholiday-advice%2Fcamping-guide%2F&data=05%7C01%7Cb.haughey%40apollocamper.com.au%7Cdc317cd824b447f9d8d708db5d385724%7C21de7db0f6844d47897fd8dcd46773bb%7C0%7C0%7C638206268775447798%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ianQsCBbmqOgnJ7p5RLSapGauJSv7tRa%2BTiphvFove4%3D&reserved=0) for more information.

- [**How much does it cost to park a campervan in Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/#)


The cost of parking your campervan depends on if you choose to stay in a designated campsite or one of the low-cost alternatives. Campsites range from €25- €60 per night depending on the location and facilities.



For parking, campervans and motorhomes are subject to the same rules as cars and other vehicles. Parking in built up areas will generally range from around €2.50- €10 per hour.

# On the road support

While you are enjoying your motorhome holiday across the UK or Ireland with Bunk Campers, it is always reassuring to know that if you do need a helping hand, there is always one available should you need it. It’s all about keeping you on the open road, and if you have a problem, we have a solution.

All guests who hire a campervan or motorhome from Bunk Campers benefit from the following support:

- **24/7 campervan roadside assistance**
- **Bunk Campers vehicle support team**
- **Demonstration YouTube videos to learn how to use your motorhome for quick and easy assistance on the road**
- **Helpful tips and answers to FAQs**
- **A Rental Companion**
- **Directions to Bunk Campers depots**

# Packing Tips for your Campervan Holiday in the UK & Ireland

![Campervan Holiday Checklist Hero Image](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/campervan-holiday-check-list.jpg)

### If this is your first campervan hire Ireland or campervan hire UK holiday, you are probably wondering what you’ll need to bring! Our holiday checklist gives you hints and tips on what to bring for your comfort and convenience.

### **We supply the basics:**

- Pots & Pans
- Gas Kettle
- Utensils
- Crockery
- Cutlery
- Dustpan & Brush
- Electric Mains Hookup Cable
- Water Hosepipe
- Fire Extinguisher
- First Aid Kit

### **We Offer Hireable Extras:**

For your comfort and convenience you can hire extras for your campervan such as bedding (to reduce your airline baggage allowance!), Satellite Navigation (to avoid getting lost on your way to the campsite!) or mobile Wi-Fi (to stay connected on the road!). For a full list of our optional extras for your campervan hire Ireland or campervan hire UK holiday, visit our **[campervan hireable extras](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hireable-extras/)** page.

### **What to Pack?**

All general supplies can be bought locally. Major food, convenience and accessories shops are open 7 days a week across the UK and Ireland and a convenience store is never too far away so don’t worry if you haven’t packed a consumable.

**It’s a good idea to pack your gear in soft luggage bags as they are a lot easier to store in your campervan than a hard suitcase.**

**Documents**

- **A valid Drivers Licence is _essential_ for all named drivers on your booking to complete insurance requirements at check in.**
- Make sure to pack any tickets, identification documents and **Bunk Campers Booking Confirmation** to ease your check in! If you are travelling from outside the EU, ensure you’ve registered for a **visa** to allow entry to the UK or Ireland.
- We recommend all customers ensure they have adequate **travel insurance** to cover any eventuality ending in having to cancel or return early.
- Always ensure you have your own adequate **medical insurance**. The European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) covers any medical treatment for **EU citizens** during your trip due to illness or an accident. It is recommended if you’re travelling from a country in mainland Europe that you are resident in, that you apply for this card and bring this with you. If you are travelling from outside the EU, please ensure you have medical insurance.
- **Passports**

**Finanical**

- Bring a **valid credit or debit card** to authorise your security deposit at the depot.
- **Money/Currency** – Make sure you bring credit/debit cards and valid currency for the area you’re travelling in: £GBP for travel in England, Wales, Scotland & Northern Ireland. €EUR for travel in Republic of Ireland.

**Electronics**

- Alarm
- All Charges
- Tablet/ laptop

**Good to have:**

- **240V Travel Adapter** for use across the UK and Ireland
- **Torch** – for all your night time activities and trips!
- Clothing for all weather- The UK weather can be termpimental, be prepared and check the weather before and pack accordingly.
- Reusable water bottle.
- Slippers/ Slidders

**Fun**

- Board games
- Newspaper/ magazines
- Cards
- Books
- Journal
- Toys/ football/ baseball/ volleyball

# Scotland travel guide – Top 10 things to do!

From the snow capped peaks of the highlands to the metropolitan cities, enjoy the freedom and flexibility of Campervan hire! Why not check out [motorhome hire Scotland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/ "Campervan Hire Scotland") from Bunk Campers and tick off all of our fantastic top 10 things to do!

[![motorhome hire scotland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Scotland-castles.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Scotland-castles.jpg)

### 10\. Attend a Scottish festival

Campervan hire Scotland is the perfect way to get into festival fever! Whether you are rocking out at T in the Park, experiencing the Highland games or bringing in the new year at Edinburgh’s Hogmanay festival, Bunk Campers can get you there.

### 9\. Spot seals, dolphins and whales around the Isle of Skye

With its reflective waters and mountain scenery, the Isle of Skye is considered to be one of the most beautiful sights in Scotland. Take a boat trip trip to spot dolphins, seals and even killer whales on Scotland’s north west gem.

### 8\. Play on Mussleburgh, the world’s oldest golf course

Sink 18 holes on the world’s oldest golf course whilst admiring Scotland’s breathtaking scenery. And if that’s not enough for you, head off in your camper to one of Scotland’s other 500 world class courses!

### 7\. Follow the Malt Whiskey Trail

Cruise through Speyside in your campervan hire along the Scottish whiskey trail – the only trail of its kind in the world. Stop at all the distilleries along the way in search for the perfect malt.

### 6\. Get lost in Eilean Donan castle

History is not always in museums! Visit one of Scotland’s most iconic locations and live like a King for a day!

### 5\. Take the John O’Groates ferry to the Orkney islands

Pop your camper on the John O’Groats ferry to the Orkney Islands. Explore the natural beauty of the Islands offering spectacular coastal scenery and unique flora and fauna.

### 4\. Discover traditional Scottish haggis

Try some haggis in the local pub, chat to the lad at the bar and find out all the best off the beaten track places to discover in your camper the next morning.

### 3\. Hunt for the Loch Ness Monster

Set to a backdrop of glorious colour, admire the scenery around the loch as your tour around in your camper. Visit the discovery centre or take a boat trip acorss the water if you are brave enough to find out what lurks beneath the mysterious loch! Campervan hire Scotland gives your the freedom and flexibility to go at your own pace and enjoy the scenery.

### 2\. Visit historic Edinburgh

Step back in time and visit historic Edinburgh, where centuries of history meet a vibrant, cosmopolitan city. Visit the old and new towns, a UNESCO World Heritage site and climb the hill to Edinburgh castle for magnificent views over the city.

### 1\. Park up and wait for the spectacular Northern Lights!

Discover the stunning scenery in isolated Northern Scotland. Head to the most rural spot, warm up with a cup of tea and wait for the spectacular Aurora Borealis to appear as natures very own theatre stages centre stage! With campervan hire Scotland, you can travel to Scotland’s most remote places but never feel too far away from home in your campervan!

[![campervan hire scotland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/campervan-hire-scotland.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/campervan-hire-scotland.jpg)

# UK and Ireland Campsite Guide

![Campites & coronavirus](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/Campites-coronavirus.jpg)

Thinking of motorhome hire in the UK or Ireland but not sure where to camp? We work with campsites and camping organisations to ensure you have the best possible experience when you hire.

If you hire a campervan from any of our **[motorhome depots](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ "Campervan hire UK & Ireland"),** we provide you with a free campsite guide to help get you on the road. However, if you prefer to have more information before you arrive, here is our handy guide to campsites for your holiday (Please note: it is advisable to plan or ring ahead and book your pitch, especially during the busy summer months)

### The Caravan & Motorhome Club

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Caravan-and-Motorhome-Club-Logo.jpg)

Bunk Campers are the official rental partners of The Caravan and Motorhome Club, the UK’s number 1 touring club offering access to 2,700 of the best campsites across the UK and Europe. When you hire a motorhome from Bunk Campers you will benefit from [**The Caravan and Motorhome Club’s Campsite+ Scheme**](https://bunkcampers.com/campsite-discount-with-the-caravan-and-motorhome-club/), which offers access to the Club’s campsites at discounted rates.

[**Find out more.**](https://bunkcampers.com/campsite-discount-with-the-caravan-and-motorhome-club/)

### The UK Camping & Caravanning Club

![ccc_logo](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/ccc_logo-150x150.gif)

For campervan hire in the UK, there are dozens of campsites which are worthy of taking the top spot. Our guests enjoy temporary membership of [**The Camping & Caravanning Club Motorhome Hire Scheme**](https://bunkcampers.com/enjoy-camping-caravanning-club-member-benefits-with-you-hire-with-bunk-campers/) which offers up to 30% discount on participating sites.

[**Find out more.**](https://bunkcampers.com/enjoy-camping-caravanning-club-member-benefits-with-you-hire-with-bunk-campers/)

### Irish Caravan & Camping Council

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/ireland-camping-lgoo.png)

In Ireland we work with the Irish Caravan and Camping Council to bring you the best quality campsites and camping discounts. All guests arriving at our [**Dublin & Belfast**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/) depots will receive a copy of the Irish Camping Guide. You can view their full list of campsites and discounts [**here**.](https://www.campingireland.ie/) They also have a free app which is great for planning your trip on the go!

### Safe Nights Ireland

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/safe-nights-ireland-black.png)

If you are looking for a cheaper alternative to staying at official campsites, then Safe Nights Ireland can provide safe and cheap overnight parking for your campervan holiday. All our guests who hire a campervan in Ireland receive free membership to Safe Nights Ireland.

[**Find out more**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/safe-nights/)

### **Camping NI**

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Camping-Club-Card-Logo-Trans-2022.png)

For guests travelling in the North & South of Ireland, we have partnered with Camping NI on their ‘Camping Club Card’ to offer our guests access to campsite discounts while on their Ireland and Northern Ireland campervan holiday. Camping Club Card not only offers guests access to campsite discounts, but you can also receive discounts at attractions, activities, and restaurants in the North & South of Ireland.

Find out more

### Other campsite resources:

**[Visit Scotland  – Campsites & Holiday Parks](https://www.visitscotland.com/accommodation/caravan-camping/caravan-sites-campsites-holiday-parks/)**

From the Highlands to Islands and everywhere in between, Visit Scotland provide a comprehensive list of campsites across all corners of Scotland.

**[Discover Northern Ireland – Guide to Camping](https://discovernorthernireland.com/accommodation/camping/a-guide-to-camping-and-caravan-parks/)**

Discover Northern Ireland’s guide to camping, which includes links to a list of campsites that have been rated under the British Graded Holiday Parks Scheme and local council licensed camping parks.

### **Alternatives to Campsites**

![safe nights ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/safe-nights-ireland.jpg)

[**Safe Nights Ireland**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/safe-nights/)

Safe Nights Ireland offer a safe and cheap alternative to staying at a campsites in Ireland. We offer access to the Safe Night’s Ireland network with all Ireland rentals.

[**Britstops**](https://www.britstops.com/)

The Brit Stop book features country pubs, farm shops, breweries, etc. all offering an invitation through the Brit Stops scheme to stay overnight in your motorhome or campervan in a safe environment – free of charge! These are not camp sites, so won’t have shower blocks or overnight toilet facilities, but you do get a pleasant stopover somewhere off the road, and a bit different.

**We recommend you contact places prior to your arrival to ensure they have space. Changes, refurbs or closures can occur from time to time, and are not always able to be updated, so it is worth checking!**

**Please note, campsite alternatives won’t always offer the full range of campervan facilities you need. Don’t forget to call into a campsite every now and again to [dispose of your waste](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/waste-disposal/) responsibly, plug in for more power or just to enjoy the facilities.**

# Bunk Campers Scotland Travel Guide

Thinking of campervan or motorhome hire in Scotland? With so many tours of Scotland, it is hard to pick just a few! From historic cities to the wild, isolated highlands, Scotland travel has something for everyone. Motorhome hire is a great way to see the country at your own pace. You can stop whenever and wherever you want, and you don’t have to worry about finding accommodations each night. So whether you are looking for campervan hire in Scotland to chase the Loch Ness monster, follow the whiskey trail or dream of travelling the highlands, our handy Scotland travel guide helps connect you to all of the best Scotland tours and attractions.

### Things to do in Scotland

Scotland’s tourist attractions are magical and breathtaking! Campervan hire in Scotland can get you there – Check out our top 10 things to do in Scotland to ensure you don’t miss any!

[**Read More >**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/trip-ideas/scotland/things-to-do-scotland/)

### Scotland Maps & Guides

Campervan hire Scotland gives you the freedom & flexibility to go where you want, when you want. However, planning your trip in advance can help to make the most of your time in Scotland. Take a look at these guides and itineraries before hitting the road!

**[Read More >](http://www.visitscotland.com/e-brochures/ "Visit Scotland Brochures")**

### Driving Routes

Tours of Scotland are better in a campervan! Follow the North Coast 500, the Whiskey trail or explore the Scottish Highlands. Once thing is for sure, the views from behind the wheel of your camper will be breathtaking!

[**Read More >**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/trip-ideas/scotland/driving-routes-scotland/)

We provide [pet-friendly holidays](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/) and unlimited mileage, so what are you waiting for? Get an instant quote now from the booking widget on our website, email enquiries@bunkcampers.com or call our team on +44(0)2890813057.

# Bunk Campers Ireland Travel Guide

Campervan or motorhome hire Ireland gets you connected to all the tourist attractions, breathtaking scenery, years of ancient history, literature, music, dance and conversation.

Motorhome hire is a great way to see Ireland. You can explore the country at your own pace, and stop whenever and wherever you want. Ireland is an explorer’s dream! In a land where ancient myths are waiting to be exposed and hidden gems await discovery, getting off the beaten track is truly worthwhile! But just in case getting lost isn’t your thing, check out our handy Ireland travel guide to help you plan your road trip.

## Family favourite with bunk bed layout

# 6 Berth Motorhome Hire

With a full range of amenities & sleeping facilities, the 6-berth Grande is ideal for touring. The perfect motorhome for 4- 6 people, the Grande has a generous storage area for clothes, sports equipment, toys and games, so you can come prepared for anything and all seasons.

The Grande motorhome has been carefully designed to offer **space and comfort** in an easy to drive motorhome. Ideally suited to the UK & Ireland road network, handling scenic coastal roads, winding mountain inclines and motorways.

Sleeping up to 6 people, we recommended the Grande for 4 adults and 2 children.  It is the only Bunk Camper with the popular bunk bed layout and the added benefit of a spacious double bed in the overhead cab. The Dinette also conventionally converts into an additional bed.

The Grande also includes a fully kitted kitchen, a generous dining area and a bathroom equipped with a toilet, sink and shower. The perfect holiday lodge on wheels **.**

Hire the Grande 6-berth motorhome from any of our depots across the UK and Ireland.

_All rentals require a valid, full category B driver’s license._

## Campervans and Motorhomes for Hire in the UK & Ireland

Bunk Campers are one of the largest campervan rental companies in the UK & Ireland with depots nationwide. Since 2007, our customers have spent over 100,000 days on the road enjoying motorhome holidays. All our campervans and motorhomes are less than three years old, meaning that when you hire a campervan with Bunk Campers, you can be confident of the quality, service and maintenance of your camper.

Whether you are looking for a compact campervan or large motorhome for the whole family, Bunk Campers offer a wide range of vehicles to suit every pocket! All of our campervans and motorhomes for hire are kitted out with everything you need to get on the road. We also offer a range of [extras](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hireable-extras/) including bedding, camping furniture and a quick and easy returns service. We also offer a one-way rental service, so you can pick up your campervan from any of our depots in the [UK or Ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/) and drop it off at another. This is perfect if you’re planning a road trip and want to explore different parts of the country in your motorhome hire.

Hire a campervan from Bunk Campers and enjoy the freedom and the flexibility of the open road for your touring holiday! Why not discover the magic of the Emerald Isle on the Wild Atlanic Way, tour the magnificant North Coast 500 in Scotland, or explore the beautiful South Coast of England? All from the comfort of your very own home on wheels. So if you’re looking for an affordable way to explore the UK or Ireland, why not hire a campervan or motorhome from Bunk Campers?

_Please note, the specifications vary between different manufacturers, so this is a guide of what you can typically expect. We are unable to confirm or guarantee precise floor plans and layouts by booking._ _All rentals require a valid, full category B driver’s license._

## Tour & Relax in Style

# 2 Berth Campervan Hire

**The couples choice!** This 2 person camper has all the comfort of a motorhome but is more compact and economical to drive.

The most popular couples choice from our campervan hire fleet, the Aero campervan is the perfect **fully-equipped 2 person campervan for hire in the UK and Ireland**. This contemporary and bright campervan comes with all the benefits of a motorhome in a **more compact vehicle**, offering space and comfort for 2 people. Enjoy the Aero camper **spacious living area, stylish kitchen, comfortable seating, mood light, shower & toilet facilities and large, double bed.**

If you are looking for practical and modern campervan hire in the UK or Ireland, the Aero is the campervan for you! Why not hire this 2 person campervan and relax and tour in style?

_**All rentals require a valid, full category B driver’s license.**_

Rent the Aero campervan from: Bunk Campers **[Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/)**, **[Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/)**, **[Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/)** or **[Greater London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)** depots.

# Our Campervan & Motorhome Hire Depots are across the UK & Ireland

Bunk Campers are the only one way, multi-point location campervan hire company in the UK and Ireland.  Offering 4 pick up locations, we offer the widest choice of regional locations for your campervan hire holiday. Our rental depots are conveniently located close to airports and transport hubs, meaning you don’t need to travel far to start your driving adventure!

For **[campervan & motorhome hire in Ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/)**, we are the only company with depots in both **[Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/ "Campervan hire Dublin")** & **[Belfast,](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/ "Campervan hire Belfast")** perfect for a one-way road trip along the Wild Atlantic Way and Causeway Coastal Route. For **[campervan & motorhome hire in Scotland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/)**, our depot is conveniently located between **[Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/ "Campervan hire Edinburgh")** & Glasgow airports. For motorhome holidays in England and Wales, our depot at **[Greater London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)** offers easy access to the Great British countryside and beyond. Where you go, you decide!

### Know where you want to pick up from? Click on your preferred depot and find out more information!

[London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london "London Campervan Hire") [Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin "Dublin Campervan Hire") [Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh "Edinburgh Campervan Hire") [Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast "Belfast Campervan Hire")

### [Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/)

[![Dublin Depot](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Dublin-location-page.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/)

Conveniently located just off the M1 motorway, 15 minutes outside Dublin city centre and only 1 mile from [Dublin Airport](https://www.dublinairport.com/), campervan hire Dublin gives you quick and easy access to all of Ireland’s top tourist attractions.

[Find out more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/)

### [Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/)

[![Location page image- edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Location-page-image-edinburgh.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/)

Our Scotland motorhome hire depot, located in Edinburgh, is just 10 minutes from [Edinburgh International Airport](https://www.edinburghairport.com/) in the ideal location to connect you to Scotland’s must-see tourist attractions.

[Find out more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/)

### [Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/)

[![Location page image- Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Location-page-image-Belfast.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/)

Bunk Campers Belfast depot is just 7 miles from the city centre and 25 minutes from [Belfast City Airport](https://www.belfastcityairport.com/). Located within easy reach of all major tourist attractions, this is the ideal way to start your dream road trip.

[Find out more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/)

### [Greater London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)

[![London depot](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/London-depot.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)

Bunk Campers Greater London depot is located close to all London airports, and easily accessible through bus or train routes, making it the perfect start point to your UK road trip.

[Find out more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)

Bunk Campers celebrates its 15th anniversary in 2022, starting from humble beginnings in 2007, our award winning company has grown to be one of the largest campervan & motorhome hire companies in the UK & Ireland. We are looking forward to celebrating this year with lots of fun events, promotions and competitions, so why not follow us on social media, sign up for our E-zines and get involved.

Our founders created Bunk Campers after exploring Australia and New Zealand in a campervan, and on returning to Ireland came up with the business plan to offer a campervan rental company, that quickly grew to be Bunk Campers! Bunk Campers today is synonymous with quality, modern fleet to satisfy every customer, from vans through to luxury motorhomes.

We are the only all [Ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/ "Campervan Hire Ireland") campervan rental company and also offer campervan hire in [Scotland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/ "Campervan Hire Scotland") & [England](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/ "Campervan Hire UK"), with depots located close to Dublin, Belfast, Edinburgh, Glasgow & London airports. For campervan rental from [London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/ "Campervan Hire London"), [Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/ "Campervan Hire Edinburgh"), [Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/ "Campervan Hire Belfast") and [Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/ "Campervan Hire Dublin"),this is your one-stop-shop!

Bunk Campers offer anything from compact and stylish campervans to large apartment style motorhomes – your transport and accommodation in one. We’ve got all the kit you need to get you on the road. At Bunk Campers, our campervans are converted, fitted and kitted to our own exact specification based on our experiences. We update our fleet of campervans & motorhomes every year and all our vehicles are modern and safe! [View our campervans](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/ "Campervans for Hire in the UK & Ireland") to find out more!

### **Why rent with us?**

Here’s the facts about Bunk Campers:

#### **We offer Europe’s widest choice of campervan vehicle types**

- From budget campervan hire to luxury motorhome hire, we have the vehicle type to suit your trip.
-  We have a wide range of vehicle types for you. Choose from our range of compact 2 person camping cars and campervans, 4 person family touring campervans and large 4-6 person motorhomes.

#### **We offer** **you a modern, clean and well maintained campervan rental**

- Our vehicles are modern models from leading manufacturers across Europe
- The modernity of our fleet means that we are the only campervan and motorhome rental company in Ireland to offer you the latest fuel efficient EURO 6 ENGINES.
- We work directly with leading European manufacturers to bring you a Class A fleet and the latest innovations in campervan manufacturing

#### **We only offer vehicles made to our own exact specifications**

- We offer you a choice of vehicle types from our campervan hire fleet under the Bunk Campers brand
- This means that you will get the same standard of quality of vehicle across all our depots
- You can be confident of the service history, quality and operating standard of the vehicle whether it is on or off the road

#### **We make booking your campervan hire trip as simple and transparent as possible.**

- We offer an easy online quote and booking system which shows you alternative campervan and date options
- The basic rental rates quoted include insurance and local sales tax.
- We offer additional products and protection cover as extras so you are in control of the budget
- We offer clear and concise rates, product and service information as well as loads of other useful information in **our [FAQs](https://bunkcampers.com/en/faqs/ "Campervan Hire UK & Ireland T&Cs")**

**We offer good value for money campervan hire and motorhome rental.**

- We compete on quality, value and service
- When we talk about good value for money campervan hire, we mean value for money, not cheap vehicles
- We offer competitive daily rates, long stay discounts and special offers across our fleet so you can get a good value deal every day
- We rent out one of the UK and Ireland’s newest fleet of vehicles.

**We offer a Price Match Promise**

- If you find a cheaper Bunk Campers motorhome for the same vehicle with the same travel dates on any other website, we will match the price you found. We also offer price matches for competitors quotes. [**Learn more.**](https://bunkcampers.com/price-match-promise/)

**Choose campervan hire in the UK or Ireland with Bunk Campers and you will be renting one of the newest, freshest and fuel efficient campervans or motorhomes on the road across the UK and Ireland.**

## Greater London

# Greater London Campervan & Motorhome Hire

The Bunk Campers Greater London depot is closely located to London Luton Airport, and is the perfect start to your UK road trip. Whether you are planning a short weekend getaway or an extended motorhome holiday, our Greater London depot is the perfect way to explore the UK with freedom and flexibility. When you arrive at our depot, our friendly team will greet you and give you a vehicle overview before hitting the open road.

Our Greater London depot is the ideal starting point to explore England’s must-see attractions with your motorhome rental. Enjoy your holiday at your own pace with unlimited access to everything England has to offer. From the stunning coastline of Cornwall, to the Angel of the North in Newcastle, **[Stonehenge](https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/visit/places/stonehenge/)** in Salisbury and the English countryside in the **[Peak District](https://www.peakdistrict.gov.uk/home)**, there is no shortage of places to explore on your England motorhome road trip. Visit family-friendly campsites, beauty spots, blue flag beaches and campervan hotspots.

Choose from a range of 2- 6 berth motorhomes. Your rental includes unlimited mileage, 1 driver insurance, kitchen pack, free membership to The Camping & Caravanning Club Privilege Scheme and more.

## How to book your Greater London motorhome holiday

Book your England motorhome holiday directly on our website using the live booking bar. Get live availability by selecting your pick-up depot, drop-off depot, preferred dates, country your licence was issued in, age of driver and number of guests travelling and hit search. Choose from our range of motorhomes and find the one that best suits you.

If you prefer to contact our team directly to book you can email us at bunkcampers@enquries.com or call us on [0800 059 0905](https://www.google.co.uk/search?q=bunk+campers+belfast&sca_esv=60df094e8c3a7fc5&source=hp&ei=CjrOZeS9MP6nhbIP-LmNmAk&iflsig=ANes7DEAAAAAZc5IGv4OP7qE_ikpNIxSjQnOwne99KNt&ved=0ahUKEwjk6pyp4K2EAxX-U0EAHfhcA5MQ4dUDCBA&uact=5&oq=bunk+campers+belfast&gs_&sclient=gws-wiz#).

From the family-friendly motorhomes to compact campervans, we have the perfect vehicle to suit your taste and budget. With a range of [2-6 berth motorhomes,](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/)  all our vehicles come equipped with everything you need to enjoy your motorhome holiday, including kitchen equipment and gas. We also have a range of hirable extras including bedding and towels.

**Not sure what motorhome to choose? No problem, our team are ready to help- [contact us](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) and a member of our team will assist with a personalised quote.**

## Planning your England motorhome holiday from our Greater London depot

Our Greater London depot is the perfect starting point to your England motorhome holiday. If you are driving to our Greater London motorhome rental depot, you can park your car at our depot for a small fee.

If you want to get some miles in immediately from our Greater London motorhome hire depot you can get on your dream road trip by using our Plan Your Trip section. Why not see the natural beauty of Durdle Door in Dorset, discover the magic of the Norfolk broads, or the infamous White Cliffs of Dover?

We recommend planning or pre-booking campsites prior to your trip to ensure you have somewhere to park for the night on your trip. Find out some more of our [camping advice](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/campsite-guide/)!

Book your Greater London campervan rental today and our friendly, professional team will give you a full demo of your camper before you hit the open road.  You can get live availability from our booking bar and enjoy, competitive pricing, long rental discounts, Pet-friendly vehicles, Bike Racks and Campsite discounts with every hire. Book now!

* * *

**Not sure what to choose? For more information, [contact us](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) and a member of our team will be happy to assist with a personalised quotation.**

- [**Can you wild camp with a campervan in London?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/#)


Wild camping in London is risky, and if you do “Wild Camp”, you should do so in a designated area. However it is not likely to be looked upon favourably by locals.



We recommend staying at campsites instead – but these will most likely need booked in advance.

- [**How much is it to hire a campervan in England?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/#)


Campervan hire prices vary depending on multiple factors, including your chosen dates and vehicle choice. You can use the booking bar at the top of the page for an instant quote.

- [**Do campervans have toilets?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/#)


Yes! Apart from our Nomad campervan, all of our vehicles have toilets and bathrooms on board.

- [**Can you park a motorhome anywhere in the UK?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/#)




The short answer is **no**. If you want to park somewhere off the beaten track and not in a campsite, it is advised you seek the landowners permission beforehand.

# Safe Nights Ireland

![safe nights ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/safe-nights-ireland.jpg)

Many of our guests want to find cheaper alternatives to staying in an official camp site each night of their campervan hire holiday in Ireland. The Safe Nights Ireland initiative aims to provide safe and cheap overnight parking for the campervan enthusiast.

Safe Nights Ireland has a large network of overnight parking locations offering a variety of facilities available across Ireland. From country houses, open farms, national parks to pub locations – you really can get off the beaten track! You shouldn’t expect the luxury of a campsite, but you will get a warm welcome, somewhere safe to park up and be able connect your campervan to the facilities.

### How it works!

![safe nights ireland ](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/safe-nights-ireland-black.png)

All of our guests who hire a campervan in Ireland receive FREE membership to Safe Nights Ireland.

On arrival at our depot, we will give you the membership information. Guests can then stay at any of Safe Nights Ireland sites for a small fee, much cheaper than a campsite, and make use of the site facilities. Entry to SNI sites is strictly through the membership cards so each of our vehicles is registered for you to gain access.

Please note, Safe Nights Ireland is a voluntary organisation and may not always have someone on hand to keep website information up to date. We recommend contacting any sites in advance of your arrival to ensure they can take campers.

### Leave no Trace & Waste Disposal

If you are planning on visiting Safe Nights Ireland locations for your trip, remember they might not have all the same facilities as most campsites.

Remember to stick by the [Leave No Trace](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/leave-no-trace/) principles for your trip and plan ahead for all your [waste disposal](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/waste-disposal/) needs before it’s too late!

Here’s a list of [public toilets](http://www.safenightsireland.com/useful-information/public-toilets/) available across Ireland.

### Find out more!

Click here to learn more about [Safe Nights Ireland](http://www.safenightsireland.com/) – do your research in advance so you can plan a cheaper and safer trip to Ireland.
