### Safe Driving in your campervan or motorhome

With your campervan hire, many of you will be driving a large vehicle for the first time, some on the other side of the road. This requires you to be mindful of the different skills required to stay safe while driving even if you are an experienced driver.

During your check-in, we will advise you on how to handle the campervan on the road. When you are on the road in your campervan, **your safety is your responsibility**. Here are some of our campervan rules & safety tips to help you along the way.

### **Plan your journey and give yourself extra time**

Give yourself time to get to your destination.  Call ahead if you are going to be late so you are not under pressure. Aim to set off and arrive at your destination in daylight.

### Speed Limits

Please take note of any signs showing lower speed limits than stated below. These may be there due to additional hazards on the road and should be followed.

**Ireland**

In the Republic of Ireland, speed limits are given in kilometres per hour (km/h).

In Northern Ireland they are posted in miles per hour (mph).

- **Republic of Ireland**

_Motorways:_ 120km/h

_National roads:_ 80km/h

_Towns and built up areas:_ 50km/h
- **Northern Ireland**

_Motorways:_ 70mph

_Open road:_ 60mph

_Towns and built up areas:_ 30mph

Be sure to remember the change when you cross the border! There is no checkpoint so it is easy to cross without realising.

**UK**

In England, Scotland & Wales, like Northern Ireland, speed limits are posted in miles per hour and are as follows:

_Motorways:_ 70mph

_Dual carriageways: 70_ mph

_Built-up areas:_ 30mph

_Outside built-up areas:_ 60mph

It is quite common around residential areas and particularly near schools, for a clearly signposted 20mph (32 kmph) maximum speed limit.

Please be aware that remote speed cameras are positioned on many roads.

### **Ignore Speeders**

Don’t be put under pressure by the vehicle behind you. Maintain the speed that you are comfortable with that keeps in control of the campervan. Pull in and let them overtake you.

### Rules of the Road

Driving is on the left throughout UK & Ireland. So, make sure to pay extra attention at crossroads and roundabouts. Always turn left onto a roundabout and give way to traffic approaching from the right.

Seat belts must be worn at all times and by everyone in the vehicle.

Overtake on the right unless there is a steady solid white line which means no overtaking.

Don’t be tempted to tailgate to make the driver in front go faster. If the traffic needs to break suddenly you may require a longer stopping distance than your normal vehicle to avoid a collision

It is illegal to use a hand held mobile phone whilst driving and will incur a hefty fine.

The laws on drink driving are very strict and penalties are high. The legal limit is 80mg per 100ml of blood which is approximately 1 pint of beer.

### Parking

Parking is allowed wherever you see sign marked with a red P.

A diagonal line crossing the sign means parking is prohibited.

Double yellow lines mean no parking at any time.

It is permissible to park on the street unless indicated otherwise. However be sure to check there isn’t a parking scheme in place in which case you will have to purchase a parking ticket from a machine.

### Diesel

There are plenty of gas stations throughout the country however, distances between stations can be longer in rural areas so please make sure you fill up appropriately. Many are self service and nearly all take major credit cards. All our campervans use diesel fuel so make sure you use the correct pump!

### On the Road

Always remember to take regular breaks whilst driving especially when traveling long distances.

In some parts of Ireland, road signs are posted in both English and Irish.

Be aware that many roads in rural areas are single track and are so small that one vehicle will have to pull over to let the other pass.

It is also easy to underestimate the time it takes to drive between two points. Roads are small, windy and often congested and it is common to be held up by a tractor, locals chatting or even a flock of sheep! Please exercise particular caution when driving.

Learn more about our on the road support [here](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/apolloconnect/).

### Safe Driving in Scotland

For more information on Safe Driving in Scotland, please watch this short video from Visit Scotland.

# **Enjoy Exclusive Discounts on Ferry crossings when your hire from Bunk Campers**

Bunk Campers are official rental partners of the Caravan and Motorhome Club. As part of hiring a campervan or motorhome with Bunk Campers, our guests benefit from access to fantastic savings on ferry crossings when you book your ferry with the Club.

Whether it’s crossing the Irish sea on a one-way rental or taking your motorhome to Mainland Europe via Dover-Calais, further afield and everywhere in between, taking your motorhome on the ferry is flexible and convenient.

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Caravan-and-Motorhome-Club-Logo.jpg)

### **Here’s how our guests can benefit:**

- **Large choice of carriers:** Enjoy reduced rates on ferry crossings with top operators including Stena Line, P&O, Irish Ferries, Brittany Ferries, DFDS & more.

- **Wide Range of Routes**: Access a variety of ferry routes across Europe.

- **Easy booking**: Our guests can book their ferry crossing directly with The Caravan and Motorhome Club at their leisure, either online or over the phone.

### **How to Access Discounts on ferry crossings:**

- **Hire a Campervan Motorhome**: Book your motorhome with us and receive a unique membership number for the Caravan and Motorhome Club. Details on how to get your membership number can be found on your booking confirmation.

- **Book Your Ferry**: Use your unique membership number to book a ferry crossing directly with the Club and benefit from discounted rates. [**Visit the Caravan and Motorhome Club ferry offers page**](https://www.caravanclub.co.uk/overseas-holidays/book-a-crossing/ferry-offers) to view routes, offers and book your ferry crossing.

- **Enjoy the Savings**: Use your membership number to access the exclusive discounts and enjoy your journey!

### **Plan Your Adventure Today**

Don’t miss out on these fantastic savings. Book your campervan or motorhome hire with us and start planning your next adventure with the added benefit of discounted ferry crossings.

# Responsible Motorhoming with Bunk Campers

At Bunk Campers, we recognise the importance of responsible tourism for campervan and motorhome hire. Our priority is to keep you safe and informed when you travel across the UK & Ireland.

Read our Responsible Motorhoming Guide which covers the Leave No Trace principles, safe driving advice & more as you prepare for your next motorhome hire road trip.

### Safe Driving

Tips and advice for staying safe and fresh on the road. Information on rules of the road, speed limits, refueling and parking.

**[Read More >](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/driving-advice/ "Campervan Hire UK & Ireland Driving Advice")**

### Wild Camping

Rules, regulations and important advice to be aware of, before you go Wild Camping.

**[Read More >](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/wild-camping/)**

### Leave No Trace Principles

An explanation on the principles aimed to create sustainability in our natural environment.

**[Read More >](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/leave-no-trace/)**

### Waste Disposal

Campervans & motorhomes have some additional disposal needs. Read our guidance on responsible waste disposal on your holiday.

**[Read More >](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/waste-disposal/)**

### Looking After your Campervan

Tips to take care of your camper from parking up to plugging in, campervan cleaning tips and maintenance.

**[Read More >](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/campervan-advice/ "Campervan Hire UK & Ireland Safety Tips")**

## Campervan Optional Extras

![Hireable Extras Hero Image](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/hireable-extras.jpg)

At Bunk Campers, your rental comes with all you need to enjoy a great driving adventure. But if you are looking for some extra comfort and convenience, **we offer a wide range of optional extras & services to make your motorhome holiday as care-free as possible!**

Choose your preferred extras & services when booking your campervan online or [**contact our team**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) to add any of them to your existing booking!

- ![Value Pack Optional Extra](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/value-pack-optional.jpg)





### Value Pack



Our best seller for a reason! To help you get on the road, we've bundled together our most popular items to maximize your savings! (max 15 nights)
✔CDW £350/€400; Reducing your liability in the event of any accident or damage to £350/€400
✔Windscreen, mirror and tyre cover
✔Camping Furniture; Enjoy al fresco dining with camping table and chairs for the whole family
✔Bedding; Sleep soundly with bedding, pillows and bath towels for the whole family
✔Toilet Chemicals; A must to ensure a sweet-smelling and hygienic toilet
✔One additional driver



**£60 / €65 per night**

- ![Bedding](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/bedding.jpeg)





### Bedding Kit



Our bedding kits for hire are available in single and double sets. Consisting of: duvet & cover, pillow & towel



**Single £35 / €40 per set I Double £55/ €65 per set**

- ![chairs-table](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/chairs-table.jpeg)





### Camping Furniture



Outdoor table & chairs for up to 6 people. Ideal for sitting outside your campervan or taking to the beach! With easy set-up and take down, these store away easily. Perfect for a dining, lounging or playing games while taking in the scenery!



**£45/ €50**

- ![Child Seats](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/child-seat.jpeg)





### Child Seats



You can hire a child seats from 1-4 years and child booster seats from 4-11 years. All of our vehicles have at least 2 forward facing seats in the rear.

Our depots have a limited supply so we advise that you book your child seat in advance of pick up.



**£30 / €35**

- ![Additional Driver Optional Extra](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/additional-driver-extras.jpg)





### Additional Driver



Add cover for additional drivers and share driving duties when you are travelling new & exciting destinations.



**£12.50 / €15 per night**

- ![Pet friendly optional extra](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/pet-friendly-optional-extra.jpg)





### Pet Cover



All of our vehicles are pet friendly.

A maximum of 2 pet dogs per booking for a small fee.



**£50/ €60**

- ![Gas](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/gas.jpeg)





### Full Gas Bottle



A partially full bottle of gas will be provided to you upon picking up your vehicle. If you are going to be on the road and not able to connect to an external power outlet, gas can power some of the amenities in your campervan, such as cooking, heating & hot water.





**£40**

- ![Toilet tabs](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Toilet-tabs.jpg)





### Toilet Chemicals



Our campervans come equipped with on board toilet facilities. Hire toilet chemicals for the ease & convenience of not having to worry about picking them up on your campervan holiday & keep your toilet smelling fresh and clean!



**£12/ €15 per hire**

- ![Drop and go](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Drop-and-go-e1684767585460.png)





### Drop & Go



Our premium returns service. When guests select our Drop & Go service, we will take care of:

✓ Last empty of fridge/freezer
✓ Last empty of rubbish
✓ Tidying & removing bed linen & towels
✓ Packing kitchen boxes on return
✓ Return fuel tank empty (a full tank of fuel will be provided at pick up)
✓ Priority key drop
\\* Excludes emptying of Toilet Cassette and empty of Grey Water Tank









**£195/ €235**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Flexible-Change-Cover.jpg)





### Flexible Change Cover



Our Flexible Change Cover gives guests the flexibility to make one amendment and one cancellation to their booking without fees.

Cancel free of charge up to 14 nights before the pick up date.
One free booking amendment (subject to availability).
Flexible Change Cover must be added at the time of booking.
The guest is liable to pay any price increase on the booking due to the amendment.

Full details available in our terms and conditions.



**£50 / €60**

- ![Easy Returns](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Easy-Returns-1-e1684767612315.png)





### Easy Return



Take the hassle out of returning your motorhome. When guests select our Easy Returns service, we will take care of:


✓ Last empty of fridge/freezer
✓ Last empty of rubbish
✓ Tidying & removing bed linen & towels
✓ Packing kitchen boxes on return
\\* Excludes emptying of Toilet Cassette and Grey Water Tank




**£50 / €60**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/bike.jpg)





### Bike Rack



Holds up to three bikes

\*May not be available for Mystery vehicle options



**£45 / €50**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/blocks.jpg)





### Levelling Blocks



Keep your motorhome perfectly level. Ridged surface to grip to the vehicle tyres. Lightweight and made in rust-proof material, easy to clean and UV-resistant. Will not crack or break like wood. Can support vehicles with a maximum axle weight of 5 tons. Non-skid finish. Sold in pairs.



**£25 / €30**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/snow.jpg)





### Snow Chains



Snow Chains for your front wheels if you are heading out in the snow.



**£25 per set**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ad-blue.jpg)





### Adblue



10ltr bottle.



**£20 / €25**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Parking.jpg)





### Parking



Available in Greater London, Edinburgh and Belfast. Parking is not available in Dublin.



**£10 per night**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Untitled-design-51.png)





### Edinburgh Airport Transfers



We offer transfers from Edinburgh Airport to our Edinburgh depot. To find out more information on this, and to add to your booking please contact our team at enquiries@bunkcampers.com or 0800 059 0905.





**£35 each way**

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Untitled-design-2.jpg)

**£15/€18 per night**

## Scotland

# Scotland Campervan Hire

Discover the magic of Scotland as a travel destination with Scotland motorhome hire. This glorious country needs as much time as you can give it – and it still won’t feel like enough! Begin your Edinburgh campervan hire adventure from our [Edinburgh depot](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/), just 10 minutes from [Edinburgh International Airport](https://www.edinburghairport.com/), and hit the open road. See infamous destinations such as Edinburgh Castle, Loch Ness and Ben Nevis.

Scotland is packed full of beautiful scenery such as Glen Coe Valley, the Isle of Skye and Cairngorms which are unmissable destinations for your Scotland motorhome rental. The NC500 (North Coast 500) is an infamous 516-mile beautiful Scottish adventure. This route begins and ends at Inverness Castle and includes visits to John O’Groats, Glenfinnan Viaduct and Wester Ross.

Enjoy the road trip of a lifetime with Scotland motorhome hire. Try some traditional Scottish haggis or black pudding, wet the whistle with a Scotch whisky trail or experience the beauty of Eilean Donan Castle.

- [Famous For](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#panel-famous)
- [Food and Culture](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#panel-foodculture)
- [Campsites](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#panel-campsites)

- ![NC500](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/nc500.jpg)



###### NC500



The North Coast 500 links the best attractions of the north Highlands and is a must-see. The perfect route for your campervan rental.

- ![Ben nevis](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/ben-nevis.jpg)



###### Ben Nevis



Scotland’s highest peak at 1,345 metres above sea level. Ben Nevis takes an average of 4 hours to climb with a further 2-3 hours to climb back down, you can have a great time climbing this wonderful mountain.

- ![Loch ness](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/loch-ness.jpg)



###### Loch Ness



The largest freshwater Loch in Scotland (and the home of the Loch Ness Monster!). Take a cold water dip or a blissful walk around this infamous body of water.

- ![Fort William](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/fort-william.jpg)



###### Fort William



Known as the gateway to Ben Nevis, Fort William is one of the Highland’s best-known resorts. Take your campervan hire here and enjoy walking, dramatic scenery and even skiing if you visit at the right time of year.

- ![loch lomond](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/loch-lomond.jpg)



###### Loch Lomond



Located in southern Scotland, Loch Lomond and The Trossachs National Park. Adored by nature lovers, you can spend your time hiking, boating, fishing, stargazing, climbing, camping, cycling and exploring.

- ![shetland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/shetland.jpg)



###### Shetlands



The Northernmost point of the United Kingdom is famous for knitwear, arts and crafts, traditional music and wildlife. You can also take your motorhome rental to view the northern lights from here if the conditions are right!


- ![scotch whiskey](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/scotch.jpg)



###### Scotch Whisky



Discover the art of distilling Scotch in a certain way, making Scotch so unique. Tour the [Malt Whisky Trail](https://maltwhiskytrail.com/) around 8 distilleries by campervan – just don’t drink and drive!

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/haggis.jpg)



###### Haggis



An infamous Scottish dish, haggis is mixed with stock and contains various ingredients like oats, suet, onion, spices, and salt.

- ![black pudding](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/black-pudding.jpg)



###### Black Pudding



Black pudding isn’t for everyone but those who love it, adore it. Made from suet or fat, grain, onion, seasoning and cow or pig’s blood, all stuffed into an animal intestine.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/porridge.jpg)



###### Porridge



Part of the most important meal of the day, porridge (Or oatmeal as Americans may know it) is the blank canvas of breakfast. Add fruit, nuts, honey or whatever you’d like to make porridge your own.

- ![white pudding](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/white-pudding.jpg)



###### White Pudding



White pudding is very similar to black pudding… just without the pig’s blood.

- ![Oat cakes](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/oat-cakes.jpg)



###### Oatcakes



Similar to a cracker or biscuit, oatcakes are cooked on a griddle or baked in an oven.


- ![linwater campsite](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/linwater-JPEG.jpg)



###### Linwater Caravan Park



[Linwater Caravan Park](https://www.linwater.co.uk/) is nearby our [depot](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/) and perfect for Edinburgh campervan hire. With pitches for motorhomes and campervans plus a selection of beautifully decorated self-catering holiday lodges.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-3.jpg)



###### Forth House Caravan Site



Enjoy the quiet, open countryside and spectacular scenery from the comfort of your own caravan, motorhome or tent at Forth House Caravan Site.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-4.jpg)



###### Balloch O Dee



Balloch O’ Dee is a beautifully small farm set in stunning countryside on the edge of the Galloway National Forest Park.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-5.jpg)



###### Glen Nevis Caravan and Camping Park



An award-winning touring caravan and camping park near Fort William is set in a magnificent location in Glen Nevis, with stunning views of Ben Nevis.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-6.jpg)



###### Caolasnacon Camping and Caravan Park



Nestled in an idyllic setting just a few miles from magnificent Glencoe, in the beautiful Scottish Highlands. The ideal spot for Scotland motorhome hire.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/1-1.jpg)



###### Luss Caravan & Camp Site



A campsite that features incredible views of Ben Lomond and the Loch. Park your motorhome rental here for the night.

- ![Stirling](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/stirling.jpg)



###### Stirling



Known as the “Gateway to the Highlands”, at the heart of the city is Stirling Castle which sits upon volcanic rock. A great destination with campervan hire.

- ![Isle of Arran](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/isle-of-arran.jpg)



###### Isle of Arran



The Isle of Arran is a must-see destination, a stunning island off the west coast of Scotland. Waiting for you there is scenic mountains, plenty of outdoor activities and beaches to feel the sand in between your toes.

- ![Cairngorms](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/cairngorms.jpg)



###### Cairngorms National Park



Home to a quarter of Scotland’s native forests and some beautifully rugged scenery, visit Cairngorms National Park and take in the beautiful vistas. Perfect for a motorhome hire road trip!

- ![Eilean Donan](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/eilean-dolan.jpg)



###### Eilean Donan Castle



A small tidal island that sits alone. A famous Scottish landmark and a must-see for any motorhome rental holiday.


- ![Edinburgh castle tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/edinburgh-castle.jpg)



###### Edinburgh Castle Tour



Explore everything Edinburgh Castle has to offer including the Great Hall, Stone of Destiny and Mons Meg. And it’s right by our [Edinburgh Depot](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/) too.

- ![Whiskey](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/whiskey.jpg)



###### Whisky Tour



There is a plethora of distilleries for you to visit in Scotland. [Click here for more information about places to visit near you.](https://www.visitscotland.com/see-do/food-drink/whisky/distilleries/)

- ![Isle of Skye Tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/isle-fo-skye-tour.jpg)



###### Isle of Skye Day Tour



Visit the Fairy Pools, Fairy Glen, Neist Point Light House and much more. Switch off from the world for the day on this spectacular tour.


- ![Greyfriars Bobby](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/greyfriars-bobby.jpg)



###### Greyfriars Bobby



An infamous four-legged friend from Scottish history. See this historic Edinburgh monument of the dog that guarded his owner’s grave for 14 years until he died himself.

- ![black smith](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/blacksmith.jpg)



###### Gretna Green Famous Blacksmiths Shop



A symbol of enduring love and a truly unique romance, Gretna Green will capture your heart.

- ![finnich glen](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/finnich-glen.jpg)



###### Finnich Glen



The perfect stop on your Scotland motorhome hire adventure to this wonderful spot of nature.


- ![NC500](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/nc500tour.jpg)



###### NC500



Infamous – and for good reason. [The North Coast 500 is an unmissable road trip](https://bunkcampers.com/highlights-of-scotlands-famous-north-coast-500-driving-route/) toured by travellers from far and wide. Perfect for any Scotland campervan rental holiday.

- ![NORTH EAST 250](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/NE250.jpg)



###### North East 250



Covering Aberdeen, Moray Firth Coast, the East Coast and Cairngorms to name a few, [this road trip has you covered in your motorhome hire adventure](https://bunkcampers.com/north-east-250-itinerary/).

- ![SOUTH WEST COASTAL 300](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/SWC300.jpg)



###### South West Coastal 300



[The SWC300 is a stunningly beautiful road trip.](https://bunkcampers.com/south-west-coastal-300/) If you are seeking breathtaking scenery, enchanting coastlines and new things to do and see, this is the campervan road trip for you.

#### **Scotland Motorhome Hire FAQ’s**

- [**How old do I need to be to hire a campervan in Scotland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#)


Drivers aged 21-79 years can hire a campervan or motorhome in Scotland with Bunk Campers provided they meet the usual driving licence criteria outlined in our terms and conditions.

- [**How much does it cost to hire a motorhome in Scotland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#)


The price of motorhomes to rent varies across rental companies and locations. A rough ballpark is anywhere from £100-£200 per day for a larger 4 – 6 berth motorhome in Scotland. Smaller 2 berth campervans can range anywhere between £70 – £180 per day, depending on when you visit and what company you hire from.

- [**Can you park a motorhome anywhere in Scotland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#)


There is widespread misinformation on wild camping in Scotland, particularly due to the long tradition of freedom to roam formalised in the [Land Reform (Scotland) Act, 2003](http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2003/2/pdfs/asp_20030002_en.pdf). The Land Reform Act permits wild camping on most enclosed land (provided you follow the Scottish Outdoor Access Code/Leave no trace policy)– but it **excludes motorised vehicles and therefore does not apply to campervans or motorhomes.**



For more information please visit our **Wild Camping** page **[here](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/wild-camping/)**.

- [**Where can I travel with a motorhome in Scotland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/#)


The magic of motorhome hire means you can travel anywhere, at any time. Scotland is a country filled with immense beauty. You can travel through the small roads in the Highlands to some of the country’s famous driving routes including the North Coast 500, North East 250, South West Coastal 300 and many more.

# Campervan Advice

It is important you understand how to best take care of your camper in order to ensure you have the best campervan holiday. Here is all you need to know from parking up to plugging in, campervan cleaning tips and campervan maintenance.

### **Plug in**

Whilst on your campervan hire Ireland, campervan hire Scotland or campervan hire UK holiday, Bunk Campers recommends visiting locations with electric hook-up regularly during your rental. Plugging your campervan into facilities every few days is important in order to replenish your battery power. This powers your light, heating, toilet flush and hot water.

During the winter months in Ireland and the UK, this is particularly important and we recommend plugging in every night to ensure you have sufficient battery power to heat your campervan!

### **Get rid of rubbish**

Parking up at a campsite is an ideal time to get rid of your rubbish.

Never leave your rubbish lying around when you leave a site. Bunk Campers supports the leave no trace concept. Put your rubbish in the bins provided, recycle where possible and leave the area as you found it.

You are welcome to leave any unopened tinned or dried food, canned drinks, condiments (tea, coffee, sugar), cleaning materials and chemicals at the Bunk Campers depot for future customers.

### **Empty your toilet**

Avoid unpleasant smells in your van! To keep your van fresh, we recommend that you dispose of your waste at least every 3-4 days. This must be done at proper toilet [waste disposal facilities](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/waste-disposal/) which are available at most campsites.

### **Refresh water**

No one likes a cold shower! Your camper requires sufficient clean, fresh, water to heat your boiler for washing, cleaning and showering.

Bunk Campers recommends you fill up at each available opportunity. Water can be replenished at campsites or most fuel stations.

### **Empty your grey water tank**

To maintain an enjoyable campervan environment we recommend emptying your grey water tank regularly. By emptying your tank on a regular basis you can avoid carrying unnecessary weight which can increase your fuel costs.

### **Parking**

Please park responsibly and ensure you don’t park cross ways on bays or block public access by obstructing footpaths. Avoid parking near public parks and overhanging your motorhome across foot paths. DO NOT block Access to Piers & Harbours, Local Fishermen need access to their boats, as do Emergency Services in cases of accidents.

### **Gas**

Gas required for cooking, operating your fridge and in some vehicles, your heating and hot water. For safety reasons, gas must be turned off at all times when driving your campervan.

### **Area de service**

Throughout Ireland and the UK, service areas are available for quick and convenient campervan management. For a small fee, you can purchase 1kw of electricity or 100 litres of water plus toilet/waste water disposal and overnight parking is permitted at some service areas.

### [Read about Leave No Trace>](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/leave-no-trace/)

## England

# Campervan & Motorhome Hire UK

Get off the beaten track in England with UK campervan hire. Explore the beauty of the Lake District, eat fish and chips by the seaside in Cornwall, or take into the rich history of Stonehenge. Start your road trip off from our London depot, located just 6 minutes from our [**Greater L**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/) [**ondon**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/) depot.

England motorhome hire gives you the freedom and flexibility to enjoy a holiday at your own pace, with access to all Great Britain has to offer. Get your hiking boots on and explore the Peak District, visit Durdle Door in Dorset along the Jurassic Coast, and see the “end of the earth” at Lands End in Cornwall all on your English road trip.

Begin the adventure of a lifetime with UK campervan hire. Get stuck into some traditional English foods such as toad in the hole, shepherd’s pie or the infamous – Sunday roast dinner!

- ![Cornwall](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/cornwall.jpg)



###### Cornwall



Cornwall forms a peninsula of England encompassing wild moorland and hundreds of sandy beaches, culminating at the promontory Land’s End.

- ![Birmingham](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/Birmingham-mobile.jpg)



###### Lake District



A national park in Cumbria and a popular motorhome holiday destination. Known for beautiful scenery, glorious mountains and historic associations.

- ![peak district](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/peak-district2.jpg)



###### Peak District



Located centrally in England and covers more the 550 square miles. With stunning landscapes, hills, reservoirs, viaducts, cycleways and varied wildlife. The Peak District is nature at its best.

- ![Brighton Pier](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/brighton.jpg)



###### Brighton



Brighton is unmissable with it’s famous beach, Brighton Pier, stunning walks, busy nightlife, lively art scene, the i360 as well as the classic fish and chips!

- ![Eden project](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/edenj-project.jpg)



###### Eden Project



The visitor attraction, located in Cornwall has enormous biomes set in huge natural beauty craters. Filled with plants, enjoy the fantastic education centre and a variety of restaurants.

- ![Scafell Pike](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/scafell-pike.jpg)



###### Scafell Pike



The highest peak in England, Scafell Pike is located in the Lake District. Make sure you bring a pair of sturdy walking boots for this hike.


- ![fish and chips](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/fish-and-chips.jpg)



###### Fish & Chips



Fish and chips is a popular hot dish consisting of fried fish in crispy batter, served with chips

- ![scones](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/scones.jpg)



###### Scones



Scones are a baked good, often lightly sweetened. The scone is best served with plenty of clotted cream and strawberry jam.

- ![Full-English-Breakfast](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Full-English-Breakfast.jpg)



###### Full English Breakfast



Breakfast with all the trimmings including sausages, bacon, eggs, beans, tomatoes, mushrooms, black pudding, white pudding and toast.

- ![bread-and-butter-pudding](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/bread-and-butter-pudding.jpg)



###### Bread and Butter Pudding



A delicious pudding made with slices of buttered bread scattered with raisins, covered with an egg custard mixture seasoned with nutmeg and vanilla, and then baked.

- ![toad-in-the-hole](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/toad-in-the-hole.jpg)



###### Toad in the Hole



A traditional English dish consisting of sausages in Yorkshire pudding batter usually served with onion gravy and vegetables.

- ![jam-roly-poly](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/jam-roly-poly.jpg)



###### Jam Roly-Poly



Pudding filled with jam and sometimes cream, with a sugar or chocolate-drizzled outer coating. Made as a suet pudding rather than a cake, and served hot with custard.


- ![Home farm](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-1.jpg)



###### Home Farm



The site offers amazing views of the surrounding hills, with good walks along the Ridgeway Path and Icknield Way.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-2.jpg)



###### Low Wray Campsite



This stunning site offers a wide range of camping options including traditional pitches with waterfront, lake, meadow or woodland views.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-3.jpg)



###### Beach View Holiday Park



Beach View Holiday Park is located right beside the beach between Minsmere and Thorpeness, and close to other popular holiday destinations on the Suffolk Coast.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-4.jpg)



###### Manor Farm Campsite



A site on a quiet, family-run farm campsite located within an area of outstanding natural beauty, one mile from Seaton beach and the town centre.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-5.jpg)



###### Doward Park Campsite



A family-orientated quiet campsite located in the Wye Valley near Symonds Yat, in-between the historic market town of Ross on Wye in Herefordshire.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-6.jpg)



###### Ettie's Field



A colourful site with donkeys, Highland cows, goats, pigs and peacocks; A five-minute drive from Atherstone and 10 from Twycross Zoo.

- ![Chester Zoo](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/chester-zoo.jpg)



###### Chester Zoo



With over 500 different species of animals, there is truly something for everyone. Tigers, Elephants, Giraffes,  you name it and it’ll be here.

- ![st ives](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/st-ives.jpg)



###### St. Ives



One of England’s best-loved destinations. The town is built on a narrow peninsula. Radiating out from the idyllic harbour is quaint cobbled streets, sandy beaches and fishermen’s cottages.

- ![dover](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/dover.jpg)



###### Dover



Dover is a coastal town in England’s southeastern county of Kent. Visit medieval Dover Castle, the extensive Secret Wartime Tunnels and of course the iconic White Cliffs of Dover.

- ![scafell pike summit](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/SP2.jpg)



###### Scafell Pike



The highest peak in England, at just shy of 1000m. Get your walking boots on and head up into the clouds.


- ![wine and cheese tour england](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/wine-and-cheese.jpg)



###### English Cheese and Wine Tour



Head to the vineyards for a wonderful, fun-filled day trying different wines and of course some delightful cheese to pair with.

- ![Beefeater Gin tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/beefeater.jpg)



###### Beefeater Gin Distillery Tour



Enjoy the Beefeater Gin visitor centre, including exhibits on the gin history, distillery tours and gin tastings.

- ![harry potter tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/harry-potter.jpg)



###### Harry Potter Studio Tour London



Experience the Warner Bros. The Making of Harry Potter walkthrough exhibition in London, is probably as close as you’ll ever get to Hogwarts!


- ![brighton pier](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/brighton-pier.jpg)



###### Brighton Pier



Unlock your inner child at Brighton Pier. Enjoy arcades, the helter-skelter, waltzers, cafe’s and restaurants. Not to mention the glorious views!

- ![norfolk broads](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/norfolk-broads.jpg)



###### Norfolk Broads



The Broads National Park, made up of 30 lakes connected by rivers and dykes, lose yourself in 200 miles of tranquil waterways and wildlife.

- ![hadrians Wall](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/hadrians-wall.jpg)



###### Hadrians Wall



Hadrian’s Wall is a magnificent achievement, a fixed frontier of the Roman Empire from coast to coast, occupied by soldiers and civilians. Stretching 139 Km, learn about the Roman occupation of Britain along the way.

- ![white cliffs dover](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/white-cliffs-dover.jpg)



###### White Cliffs of Dover



See the spectacular chalk White Cliffs of Dover by the sea here, reaching 350 feet above sea level, they are simply stunning.


- ![south west 660](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/south-west-660.jpg)



###### South West 660



South West 660 is an iconic road trip from Poole in Dorset to Watchet in Somerset, following the beautiful coastline of southwest England.

- ![land of the lakes](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Land-of-the-Lakes.jpg)

Whether it’s the heritage and culture of Shakespeare’s England and the quintessentially British villages and towns, or the dramatic landscapes of Oxford and Shropshire, there’s plenty to see and do! #### **England Motorhome Hire FAQ’s**

- [**How old do I have to be to hire a motorhome in England?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/#)


Drivers aged 21-79 years can hire a campervan or motorhome in England with Bunk Campers provided they meet the usual driving licence criteria outlined in our terms and conditions.

- [**How much is it to rent a motorhome in England?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/#)


Prices to rent a motorhome in England vary across different rental companies and pick-up locations. Larger 4 – 6 berth motorhomes tend to be more expensive, and smaller campervans, 2 berths, can be more budget-friendly. At Bunk Campers, we are one of the largest motorhome rental companies in the UK & Ireland and provide a range of vehicle types to suit all budgets. You can get a live quote with the booking bar at the top of this page.

- [**Can you sleep anywhere in a motorhome in England?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/#)


In England, there is no specific law to prevent you from sleeping in your motorhome at the side of the road. However, generally, **it is not allowed** as local authorities tend to own roads and highways and they each have their own set of regulations.



Wild camping is only legal in England and Wales **if you have been granted permission by the landowner** and every bit of land is owned by a private individual.



The National Parks Authority forbid wild camping within any National Parks of England and Wales.

- [**What car licence do I need to drive a motorhome in the UK & Ireland?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/#)


At Bunk Campers, all our campervans and motorhome for hire are under 3500kg GMW so can be driven with a normal **‘B’ car driving licence.**

# Top 10 Things to do in Ireland

Not sure what to see on your campervan or motorhome hire Ireland holiday? Here is our Ireland travel advice section, find out the best places to see in Ireland, the top tourist attractions in Ireland and our top 10 things to do in a Bunk Camper!

[![campervan hire ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Untitled-11.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Untitled-11.jpg)

### 10\. Attend a music festival

Campervan hire Ireland is the ideal way to get into festival fever! Whether you want to rock out to music giants at Electric Picnic and Oxegen or experience Ireland’s rich musical pub culture, your Bunk Camper will get you there in true festival style.

### 9\. Play Golf

Some of the world’s most challenging courses set against a backdrop of rugged coastline, castles and mountains make Ireland the ideal destination to sink 18 holes. Campervan hire Ireland from Bunk Campers is your transport to all of Ireland’s best golf courses!

### 8\. Kiss the Blarney Stone

Point your camper 8km northwest of beautiful Cork City and get ready to pucker up and kiss the Blarney Stone! Once you have received the gift of the gab, admire the views from the top of the 15th century castle.

### 7\. Discover Irish Roots

Return to the land your ancestors called home. With over 80 million people claiming Irish heritage, it’s time to hop in your camper and find the nearest genealogy centre. Who knows, perhaps you will meet some relative you didn’t know you had!

### 6\. Sleep in a castle

Live like a King! Explore one of Ireland’s breathtaking castles by day and sleep in them by night!

### 5\. Make friends with locals

The Irish love to talk. Whether local lad in the bar or the friendly Inn keeper, spend 5 minutes chatting to a local and you will not only have a new best friend but you will also know where does the best fish and chips and where to find all the local hidden gems!

### 4\. Walk in the steps of a Giant

Experience the wonder of this UNESCO World Heritage site said to be created by giant Finn McCool. Explore the areas other delights in your camper including Bushmills Whiskey Distillery and Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge.

### 3\. See the Cliffs of Moher

These dramatic cliffs are a must see when visiting Ireland. Make full use of your camper by driving past all the usual tourist spots and finding a secluded spot on the cliffs. Stand as close to the cliffs as you can and watch as the Atlantic Ocean crashes into beautiful County Clare’s coastline.

### 2\. Taste great food and drink

Sip your first Guinness in Dublin before heading to Belfast for a belly busting Ulster breakfast. Sample local pub grub or a friend’s homemade bowl of Irish stew. Whatever tickles your taste buds, you are never too far away from a delicious Irish meal with your Bunk Camper.

### 1\. Tour the Ring of Kerry

Take your camper along the rugged County Kerry Coastline around the ring of Kerry. Cruise past pristine beaches, medieval ruins and stunning Irish countryside. With campervan or motorhome hire Ireland you have the freedom and flexibility to go at your own pace, stop, shop and cook along the way.

[![motorhome hire ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/motorhome-hire-ireland.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/motorhome-hire-ireland.jpg)

# **Bunk Campers Driver Eligibility**

![Driver Eligibility & Restrictions Hero Image](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/01/Driver-Eligibility-rtestrictions.jpg)

Perhaps the most important part to hiring a campervan, is to make sure you’re covered with a licence that allows you to drive a motorhome in the UK or Ireland.  That’s why, we have done the work to make sure you know if you’re covered for your trip.

Read below some of our most common questions, important driving criteria and anything else you need to know before you get your keys.

* * *

## Can you drive a motorhome on a car licence in the UK or Ireland?

**Yes!** At Bunk Campers, all of our campervans and motorhomes for hire in the UK and Ireland are under 3500kg so can be driven with a normal ‘B’ car driving licence.

* * *

## What sort of licence will I need to hire a campervan in the UK or Ireland?

To hire a campervan in the UK or Ireland, Driver(s) must hold a full valid driving licence for at least 24 months that entitles you to drive a European category B vehicle or equivalent up to 3500kg GMW.

If your driving licence is not in English or issued in the UK or EEA or Switzerland, then an international driving licence is required. A certified translation may be accepted depending on the country where the original licence was issued.

* * *

## How old do you have to be to hire a campervan in the UK or Ireland?

Drivers aged 21-79 years can hire a campervan or motorhome with Bunk Campers provided they meet the usual driving licence criteria outlined in our terms and conditions.

Please note, we are unable to hire to undergraduates and/or students under 25 years of age.

* * *

## Can I Drive a Camper in the UK or Ireland with penalty points?

You must declare at the time of booking any endorsements or penalties on your driving licence. All drivers are subject to insurance approval and there may be some instances where Bunk Campers are unable to provide cover for you as a driver, based on your driving history (e.g. If you have more than 6 penalty points imposed on your driving licence). See our **[terms and conditions](https://bunkcampers.com/en/terms/)** for more information.

* * *

## Do you meet criteria?

If you do not hold a driving licence that meets the above criteria, please [**contact our team**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) so that we can check with our insurers if we can offer driving insurance for you.

We are unable to offer driving insurance for any driver who has not held a valid driving licence for **over 2 years.**

* * *

## What do I need to bring before I pick up my camper?

All drivers must be present for collection of your motorhome. You will **need** to bring the following to the rental depot before you pick up:

- 2 Separate forms of photographic ID (Passport & Driver Licence)
- Any accompanying documents with driver licence (i.e. counterpart)

If you have a UK driving licence, we are required to check the counter part of your driving licence which is stored on the DVLA website. To do this, please bring your **national insurance number**, **driving licence number** and **postcode** to the depot for **check-in**. This will ensure we can check the counterpart of your driving licence.

UK driving licence holders can also log in to the DVLA website in advance **(** [**https://www.gov.uk/view-driving-licence**](https://www.gov.uk/view-driving-licence) **)** and receive a **check code** which will allow us to view your counterpart. Simply bring the code with you for check in and we will do the rest (N.B This is a one-time check code so please don’t test it to see if it worked!)

Alternatively, you can access the DVLA website yourself and **print the counterpart** of your driving licence **within 48 hours of check-in** and present it at the depot _._

**We are unable to insure you to drive any of our vehicles if we are not able to check your counterpart driving licence details.**

**All paper licences issued before 1998 are still valid.**

### Northern Ireland

If you have a Northern Ireland driving licence, we require both the **photo card** of your driving licence and the **paper counterpart**.

* * *

## Restrictions

Please note there are some restrictions to your rental cover that apply due to insurance regulations or legislation in the markets we operate in.

* * *

## Occupation Restrictions to rent a campervan in the UK or Ireland

The following occupations will need prior approval to hire a campervan in the UK or Ireland:

- Undergraduates and/or students under 25
- Anyone wholly or partly engaged in professional entertainment or professional sports occupations (including musicians, sports personalities, entertainers etc.)
- Service personnel born outside of the United Kingdom if they have held their full driving licence for less than twenty-four months.
- Courier services, express mail or parcel delivery if the vehicle is to be used for business purposes.
- Fast food establishments (including food delivery) if the vehicle is to be used for business purposes.
- Motor factors if the vehicle is to be used for business purposes.
- Wholesale or daily newsagent deliveries if the vehicle is to be used for business purposes.
- General dealers or street and/or market traders if the vehicle is to be used for business purposes.
- Jockeys and persons connected with racing, gaming/gambling industries or associated press.

* * *

## Can I drive my motorhome or campervan off road?

Bunk Campers campervans and motorhomes can **only** be driven on sealed or bitumen roads. Don’t be tempted to off road in a campervan!

**N.B: Driving is not permitted on the Connor Pass, County Kerry, Ireland**

Prohibited use is based on the safety of you and the vehicle and includes things like:

- Natural disasters, weather-based events or other major circumstances.
- Pushing or towing any vehicle, trailer, boat or other object unless authorised by Apollo Europe
- Racing, pace-making, speed trials, driving in a dangerous, wilful or reckless manner
- Driving the Vehicle in an unsafe or unroadworthy condition
- Driving the Vehicle on unsealed and non-public roads
- Driving the Vehicle on any and all unnumbered roads and highways

For a list of prohibited uses, see our [terms and conditions](https://bunkcampers.com/terms).

* * *

## Can I drive my campervan to Mainland Europe?

Yes. We offer Mainland Europe Travel Cover for your motorhome rental. Simply add the Mainland Europe Travel Cover when booking. Contact the team for more information.

# Plan Your Trip – Campervan Holiday Advice

When you hire a campervan in the UK or Ireland, it’s always assuring to read holiday advice and travel tips from the people who have been there before. It can be a bit overwhelming at times before your holiday with so much to consider, such as [choosing the right vehicle](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/), planning your routes, places to see, things to do and what you need to bring. That’s why, in this section, you’ll find everything you need to get you on the road and connected to all the best places in the UK and Ireland. So whether you need assurance like [what to pack](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/holiday-checklist/ "Holiday Checklist for Campervan Hire UK & Ireland"), [driving routes](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/trip-ideas/ "Trip Ideas in the UK & Ireland"), inspiration or trip ideas from people who know what they are talking about, our holiday advice and travel tips section tells you everything you need to know to make the best of your [motorhome hire Ireland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/ "Motorhome Hire Dublin & Belfast"), [motorhome hire Scotland](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/ "Motorhome Hire Edinburgh & Glasgow") or [motorhome hire London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/ "Motorhome Hire UK") holiday!

### Before you Arrive

If this is your first campervan holiday, you are probably wondering what will be supplied and what do I need to pack!

[Read more](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/ "Before your campervan hire UK & Ireland") [›](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/ "Before your campervan hire UK & Ireland")

### Responsible Motorhoming

Information and advice on driving safely and the responsible use of your motorhome & campervan hire in UK & Ireland.

[Read more>](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/on-the-road/)

### Ideas & Inspiration

What are the top 10 things to do in the UK and Ireland? Or, the best driving routes for unmissable scenery? Check out our motorhome itineraries, driving routes and more here.

[Read more ›](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/trip-ideas/ "Trip ideas for campervan hire UK & Ireland")

### Camping Guide

Whether it’s a family camping holiday or Wild Camping in the UK, check out our camping guide for all your camping dos & donts, campsite guides & exclusive campsite discounts.

[Read more ›](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/ "Camping guide for campervan hire UK & Ireland")

Following these tips will help ensure you have a safe and enjoyable motorhome road trip. So get out there and explore everything the UK and Ireland has to offer!

Whatever your budget, there’s a campervan for you.

## Glasgow

# Campervan & Motorhome Hire Glasgow

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Vista-Plus-Scotland-sunset.jpg)

There is so much to discover in Scotland and the best way to do it is with your accommodation and transport in one. When you hire a campervan in Scotland, you can travel at your own pace and enjoy the freedom and flexibility to explore everything on your Scottish wish list. Whether it’s a road trip along the famous [**North Coast 500**](https://bunkcampers.com/bunk-community/highlights-of-scotlands-famous-north-coast-500-driving-route/), a family adventure trip on the Isle of Skye, chasing the majestic [**Northern Lights**](https://bunkcampers.com/bunk-community/campervan-hire-northern-lights-accommodation/), a journey to experience the Highlands or travelling the Scotch Whisky trail, we have a campervan or motorhome for you.

As the largest campervan rental company in Scotland, guests travelling from Europe and worldwide to enjoy a motorhome holiday can take advantage of the low-cost flights to Glasgow International Airport. Our Bunk Camper depot is located in Broxburn, only 50 minutes from Glasgow International Airport and 10 minutes from Edinburgh Airport, meaning a simple and trouble-free connection to our depot, no matter what airport you fly in to.

From Glasgow you can conveniently take a taxi or uber directly to the Bunk Campers depot, or if you are travelling from Glasgow city take the Citylink Air bus directly to Edinburgh Airport and simply hop-on the 21a bus at stand E, stop at Dunnet Way and it’s a short walk to the branch where you can pick-up your motorhome in the comfort of our depot.

We are just minutes from the motorway, making it easy and convenient to get on the road with many of Scotland’s main tourist attractions within easy reach of our depot.

## Wide Range of Camper Choice

We have a wide range of [**campervans and motorhomes for hire in Scotland**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/) to suit all tastes and budgets, from budget camping cars, VW campervans to large motorhomes for up to 6 people. All our campers come fully equipped with heating, electricity, cooking and sleeping facilities.

Whatever your reason for visiting Scotland, campervan hire from Bunk Campers can get you there – your transport and accommodation in one!

**Not sure what to choose? For more information, [contact us](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) and a member of our team will be happy to assist with a personalised quotation.**

## Tour & Relax in Style

# 2 Berth Campervan Hire

**The couples choice!** This 2 person camper has all the comfort of a motorhome but is more compact and economical to drive.

The most popular couples choice from our campervan hire fleet, the Aero campervan is the perfect **fully-equipped 2 person campervan for hire in the UK and Ireland**. This contemporary and bright campervan comes with all the benefits of a motorhome in a **more compact vehicle**, offering space and comfort for 2 people. Enjoy the Aero camper **spacious living area, stylish kitchen, comfortable seating, mood light, shower & toilet facilities and large, double bed.**

If you are looking for practical and modern campervan hire in the UK or Ireland, the Aero is the campervan for you! Why not hire this 2 person campervan and relax and tour in style?

_**All rentals require a valid, full category B driver’s license.**_

Rent the Aero campervan from: Bunk Campers **[Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/)**, **[Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/)**, **[Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/)** or **[Greater London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)** depots.

2.

## WHO ARE WE?

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

2.1

Tourism Holdings Limited (thl) is a global family of RV brands delivering the most
enriching way to experience the world. We are listed on the New Zealand and Australian
Stock Exchanges. We believe in championing a way of traveling that creates true value
for the people, places, and environments we touch. Together, we are more vertically
integrated, globally connected, and ambitious than anyone else in RV. We design and
build. We rent. We sell. We deliver to hundreds of thousands of customers every year
across our operations in New Zealand, Australia, United Kingdom & Europe, USA, and
Canada; and franchises in Southern Africa and Japan. Amplified by our connections into
the broader tourism industry and manufacturing sectors. Collectively we represent over
30 brands, each with strong brand equity and local heritage in the markets they operate.
Details of our brands can be found [here](https://www.thlonline.com/businesses).

2.2

Together we are the data controllers for the purposes of this policy, which is issued on
behalf of all brands and entities within the thl group of companies (thl group). When we
mention "thl", "we", "us" or "our" in this privacy Policy, we are referring to the relevant
entity in the thl group responsible for processing your data. For any privacy related
enquiries contact our Chief Privacy Officer at [privacy@thlonline.com](mailto:privacy@thlonline.com).

2.3

We also use a network of independent agents and licensees when providing our services
around the world. Please note that those agents and licensees are not covered by this
Policy, and we are not responsible for the privacy practices of any agent, licensee or
other third party with whom you may transact before or at the same time as using our
products or services.

* * *

3.

## THE DATA WE COLLECT ABOUT YOU

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

3.1

The data we collect will depend on how we have interacted with you and what services
and products you have requested from us over time. We may collect, use, store and
transfer different kinds of personal data about you, which we have grouped together as
follows:

01. **Identity Data** includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier, title,
     date of birth, age, gender, driver’s licence, passport details, security camera
     recordings and recordings of telephone conversations.
02. **Contact Data** includes address, telephone numbers and email address.
03. **Financial Data** includes payment card details. We do not store any customer
     credit/debit card information as this is managed by a payment gateway provider
     who are PCDI DSS compliant.
04. **Transaction Data** includes details of your previous bookings with us, payments to
     and from you and other details of products and services you have purchased from
     us.
05. **Technical Data** includes internet protocol (IP) address, your login data, browser
     type and version, time zone setting and location, browser plug-in types and
     versions, operating system and platform and other technology on the devices you
     use to access this website.
06. **Location Data** includes global position system vehicle tracking and diagnostics
     (telematics) and other location information obtained from smartphones, tablets,
     sat-navs or other devices that monitor your current and previous geographic
     locations.
07. **Profile Data** includes your username and password, purchases or orders made by
     you, your interests, preferences, feedback, and survey responses. Data related to
     any loyalty programme membership.
08. **Usage Data** includes information about how you use our website, products, and
     services.
09. **Marketing and Communications Data** includes your preferences in receiving
     marketing from us and our third parties and your communication preferences.
     Data shared for any market research, surveys, or competitions.
10. **Vehicle-sourced Data** includes information collected by data systems within a
     vehicle about its condition and performance (including mileage, fuel, and other
     operational data) and your operation of the vehicle, including your speed, time,
     fuel consumption and distances travelled.

3.2

We also collect, use, and share **Aggregated Data** such as statistical or demographic data.
For example, we may aggregate your Usage Data to calculate the percentage of users
accessing a specific website feature. However, if we combine or connect Aggregated
Data with your personal data so that it can directly or indirectly identify you, we treat
that combined data as personal data which will be used in accordance with this Privacy
Policy.

3.3

We do not collect any information about criminal convictions and offences, although we
may be required to briefly hold and pass on any driving infringements that you incur
while renting our vehicles.

3.4

**Refusal to provide your personal data:** You do not have to provide your personal data
when we request it, but if you choose not to, we may not be able to respond to your
queries and perform any contract we have or are trying to enter into with you (for
example, to provide you with a rental vehicle). That may mean we have to cancel a
product or service you have with us. We will notify you at the time if that is the case.

* * *

4.

## HOW WE COLLECT YOUR PERSONAL DATA

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

4.1

We use different methods to collect personal data from and about you including
through:

1. **Direct interactions.** You may give us your Identity, Contact and Financial Data by
    filling in forms on our websites and mobile applications, on third-party websites
    or in paper form or by corresponding with us by post, phone, email or otherwise.
    That includes personal data you provide when you:

1. make an inquiry or booking with us or otherwise apply for any of our
       products or services.

2. purchase a product or service from us.
3. create an account on our website or mobile applications.
4. subscribe to our services or publications.
5. request marketing to be sent to you.
6. enter a competition, promotion, or survey (including on third party social media platforms).
7. give us feedback or enter our premises on which security cameras are operating.
8. speak to us on the telephone.

3. **Automated technologies or interactions.** As you interact with our website and
    mobile applications, we may automatically collect Technical Data about your
    equipment, browsing actions and patterns. We collect this personal data by using
    cookies, server logs and other similar technologies. We may also receive
    Technical Data about you if you visit other websites employing our cookies.
    Please see our cookie policy [here](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy/cookiepolicy) for further details. We may combine Technical
    Data (some of which will be anonymous) with other personal data we have
    collected from you in order to understand and measure your online experiences
    and determine what products, promotions and services are likely to be of most
    interest to you.
4. **Third parties or publicly available sources.** We may receive personal data about
    you from various third parties and certain public and technical sources:

1. **Technical Data** from analytics providers such as Google and advertising
       networks such as Facebook and Identity, Location and Vehicle Sourced
       Data when using our vehicles.
2. **Identity and Contact Data** when you make a booking or apply for our
       products or services through a third party (such as a travel agent), through
       interactions (including transactions) with our service providers, business
       partners, agents, affiliates and subsidiaries (including other travel
       providers and insurance companies), from data brokers or aggregators
       such as Facebook and from publicly availably sources such as phone
       directories, membership lists, professional and trade associations,
       government, bankruptcy or court registry searches and electoral registers.

6. **Unsolicited personal data.** If we receive personal data that we have taken no
    active steps to collect (such as a customer complaint or testimony that has been
    sent with personal information), then we may keep that personal data if it is
    reasonably necessary for one or more of our functions or activities.

## Marketing

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

6.1

We aim to provide you with choices about how your personal data is used for marketing
and advertising purposes.

consented to receiving those communications. We may use your personal data collected
in those circumstances to contact you and keep you up to date with the latest news,
events, special offers and promotions of our brands, including by email, text messages or
post.

6.3

You can update your subscription preferences or unsubscribe from marketing
communications at any time by following the update preferences or unsubscribe
instructions provided in each such communication. Alternatively, you can contact us at
[privacy@thlonline.com](mailto:privacy@thlonline.com) or by clicking [here](mailto:privacy@thlonline.com?subject=Data%20Privay%20Request). Once you do this, we will update our records
to ensure that you do not receive further marketing messages.

6.4

We may display advertising for you to see on third party websites, including social media
sites such as Facebook. We do this by matching information about your activity on thl
group websites with information collected on third party sites. That may involve using
your Identity, Contact, Technical, Usage and Profile Data to form a view on what we
think you may want or need, or what may be of interest to you.

9.

## INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

9.1

As a global company we operate our business in multiple regions and countries. This
means we collect, store, process and transfer personal information across borders
including countries outside your region or the European Economic Area, Switzerland,
and the United Kingdom (EEA+). For the most part, your personal data is collected,
stored, and processed outside the EEA+ with datacentres in Australia, Canada and USA

9.2

Certain entities in the thl group may collect personal data inside the EEA+.

9.3

If we transfer your personal data out of the EEA+, we ensure a similar degree of
protection is afforded to it by ensuring at least one of the following safeguards is
implemented.

1. We will only transfer your personal data to countries that have been deemed to
    provide an adequate level of protection for personal data by the relevant EEA+
    body.
2. Where we have entered into approved standard contractual clauses with the
    recipient to give personal data the same protection it has in the EEA+.
3. Where we use providers based in the US, we may transfer data to them if they
    are part of the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the UK Extension to the EU-US
    Data Privacy Framework, or the Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework which requires them to provide similar protection to personal data shared between the EEA+
    and the US.

9.4

Please contact us if you want further information on the specific mechanism used by us
when transferring your personal data out of the EEA+ as per contact details in section
[12.1](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#how-long-will-you-use-my-personal-data-for)

.


9.5

For individuals residing outside of the EEA+, if we disclose any of your personal data to a
foreign entity established outside of the jurisdiction in which the personal data is
collected, we will comply with any applicable laws relating to the offshore disclosure of
such personal data.

10.

## YOUR RIGHTS

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

10.1

Depending on the privacy laws applicable in the jurisdiction in which you reside, you
may have the following rights in relation to your personal data.

1. **Access:** you can request access to a copy of the personal data we hold about you
    and to check that we are lawfully processing it.
2. **Rectification:** you can request that any incomplete or inaccurate data we hold
    about you is corrected, though we may need to verify the accuracy of the new
    data you provide to us
3. **Erasure:** when your data is no longer needed for the purposes for which it was
    provided, we will delete it. You can ask us to delete or remove your personal data
    where there is no good reason for us continuing to process it, where you have
    successfully exercised your right to object to processing (see below), where we
    may have processed your information unlawfully or where we are required to
    erase your personal data to comply with local law. Note, however, that we may
    not always be able to comply with your request of erasure for specific legal
    reasons which will be notified to you, if applicable, at the time of your request.
4. **Object to processing:** where we are relying on a legitimate interest (or those of a
    third party) and you believe our processing of your personal data impacts your
    fundamental rights and freedoms, you may object to such processing for direct
    marketing purposes. In some cases, we may demonstrate that we have
    compelling legitimate grounds to process your information that override your
    rights and freedoms.
5. **Restrict processing:** you can ask us to suspend the processing of your personal
    data: (a) if you want us to establish the data’s accuracy; (b) where our use of the
    data is unlawful but you do not want us to erase it; (c) where you need us to hold
    the data even if we no longer require it as you need it to establish, exercise or
    defend legal claims; or (d) you have objected to our use of your data but we need
    to verify whether we have overriding legitimate grounds to use it.
6. **Data portability:** you can request that your personal data is transferred to you or
    a third party. We will provide you or a third party you have chosen with your
    personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format. Note that this right only applies to automated information that you initially provided
    consent for us to use or where we used the information to perform a contract
    with you.
7. **Withdraw consent:** you may withdraw your consent to our processing of your
    personal data. If you do so, we may not be able to provide certain products or
    services to you. We will advise you if that is the case when you withdraw your
    consent.
8. **Opt-out:** In some states in the United States, you may have the right to opt out of
    (i) targeted advertising, (ii) the sale of personal data, or (iii) profiling in
    furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects
    concerning you. To provide you with more interesting and customized
    information, promotions, and advertising, we disclose personal data to thirdparty providers of advertising services who may use such personal data for their
    own purposes or to serve other customers, including to display our
    advertisements to you on sites and services that we do not operate. If you reside
    in certain states in the United States, you have or will soon have the right to opt
    out of the use of your personal data for these targeted advertising or crosscontext behavioral advertising purposes. To submit such a request, please click
    the following link: [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information: Your Opt-Out\\
    Rights](https://thl.widen.net/content/3owcnobwcm/pdf/Notice-of-right-to-opt-out_Feb-2024.pdf), in which case we will respond to your request in accordance with
    applicable law.

10.2

The rights and options described above are subject to limitations and exceptions under
applicable law. We will respond to your requests to exercise your privacy rights in
accordance with applicable law. We may request additional information from you to
verify your identity and complete your request. If we deny your request, we will explain
why. In some states in the United States, you have the right to appeal our denial of your
request, which you may exercise by responding to the message we send to you
communicating our denial stating that you appeal our decision. In these cases, we will
reconsider your request and then notify you of our decision.

10.3

If you wish to exercise any of the rights set out above, please contact our Data
Protection Officer (see section [12.1](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#how-long-will-you-use-my-personal-data-for) below)

10.4

**No fee usually required:** You will not have to pay a fee to access your personal data (or
to exercise any of the other rights). However, we may charge a reasonable fee if your
request is clearly unfounded, repetitive, or excessive and it is permissible under local law
to do so. Alternatively, we may refuse to comply with your request in these
circumstances if permitted by applicable local law. If we choose to deny your request,
we will inform you of the decision and your right to complain to the supervisory
authority within the statutory deadlines, which is generally 1-month from the date of
the request.

10.5

**What we may need from you:** We may need to request specific information from you to
help us confirm your identity and ensure that personal data is not disclosed to any
person who has no right to receive it.

10.6

**Time limit to respond:** We respond to all legitimate requests without undue delay and
at the latest within one month. Occasionally, if your request is particularly complex or
you have made a number of requests, we may need to extend this by up to a period of
two months or such other timeframe as may be permitted by applicable law, in which
case we will notify you and keep you updated.

* * *

11.

## PROTECTING YOUR PERSONAL DATA

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

11.1

We have put in place security measures to protect your personal data from being
accidentally lost, used, or accessed in an unauthorised way, altered, or disclosed. In
addition, we limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors
and other third parties who have a business need to know. They will only process your
personal data on our instructions, and they are subject to a duty of confidentiality. We
regularly review our security procedures to consider new technologies and methods.

11.2

We have put in place procedures to deal with any suspected personal data breach and
will notify you and any applicable regulator of a breach where we are legally required to
do so.

12.

## HOW LONG WILL YOU USE MY PERSONAL DATA FOR?

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

12.1

We will only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes we
collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting or reporting
requirements

12.2

To determine the appropriate retention period for personal data, we consider the
amount, nature, and sensitivity of the personal data, the potential risk of harm from
unauthorised use or disclosure of your personal data, the purposes for which we process
your personal data and whether we can achieve those purposes through other means
and the applicable legal requirements.

15.

## GLOSSARY

[Back to top](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy#thlonlinePrivacyWrapper)

15.1

**Comply with a legal or regulatory obligation** means processing your personal data
where that is necessary for compliance with one of more of our legal or regulatory
obligations.

15.2

**Data controller** means whomever determines the purposes and means of processing
personal data. Legitimate Interest means our interests in conducting and managing our
business to enable us to give you the best service/product and the best and most secure
experience. We make sure we consider and balance any potential impact on you (both
positive and negative) and your rights before we process your personal data for our
legitimate interests. We do not use your personal data for activities where our interests
are overridden by the impact on you (unless we have your consent or are otherwise
required or permitted to by law).

15.3

**Performance of Contract** means processing your data where that is necessary under a
contract with you or to take steps at your request before entering into such a contract.

15.4

**Personal data** means any information about an individual that can be used to identify
that person directly or indirectly by reference to a range of identifiers. It does not
include anonymous data where the identity of the individual has been removed.

15.5

**Processing** means any operation or set of operations performed on personal data.

15.6

**Processor** means the entity that processes personal data on behalf of the controller.
