# **Scegli il tuo camper**

Abbiamo una vasta gamma di camper e caravan adatti fino a 6 persone e a tutte le tasche. Noi di Bunk Campers vogliamo offrire veicoli più comodi da guidare, più compatti e più efficienti dal punto di vista dei consumi rispetto a una roulotte o a un camper convenzionale. Con chilometraggio illimitato, assicurazione del conducente (per conducenti da 2 1 a 80 anni\*), possibilità di cucinare e fino al 30% di sconto sui campeggi del Regno Unito inclusi, cosa ti ferma? E con il nostro servizio di soccorso stradale 24 ore su 24, avrai la massima tranquillità durante il tuo viaggio. \*si applicano termini e condizioni

- ![Aero Main Vehicle Image](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Bunk_Campers_Aero_UK_IE_Exterior.jpg)



L’AERO (2 posti) è un furgone che offre comfort e comodità in uno spazio compatto. Il modello perfetto per coppie ed esploratori solitari.

[Visit website](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/2-person-aero/)

Offre tutto ciò di cui potreste aver bisogno sulla strada e una disposizione flessibile per dormire.

## Beleef jouw Bunk Campers ervaring langs de Wild Atlantic Way

# Beleef jouw Bunk Campers ervaring langs de Wild Atlantic Way

- [![Campervan Hire](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/FEATURED-e1586248856443.jpg)](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/FEATURED-e1586248856443.jpg)

‘Spectaculair’, ‘inspirerend’, ‘indrukwekkend’… geen term is goed genoeg om de ongetemde westkust van Ierland te beschrijven. Met ontelbare verborgen juweeltjes en natuurlijke schatten is **de Wild Atlantic Way de perfecte bestemming voor een avontuur waarvan je wilt dat het nooit eindigt.** Een ongerepte kustlijn, betoverende kastelen, onvergankelijke folklore, onvergetelijke zonsondergangen… **Er is geen betere manier om dit allemaal te ontdekken dan in jouw huis op wielen.** Camper huren in Ierland biedt transport en accommodatie in één, wat je de mogelijkheid biedt om de 2500 km lange route te ontdekken in je eigen tempo, zodat je het meeste kan halen uit jouw avontuur.

Vergeet het boeken van een aantal B&B adressen, te dure huurauto’s, zware bagage van de ene naar de andere locatie dragen, knoeien met een tijdschema en je tijd verdoen terwijl je wacht op tourbussen. Beleef de _Bunk Campers ervaring_ en geniet van een **unieke, betaalbare, onafhankelijke tour door Ierland in een camper**!

Haal jouw camper van Bunk Campers op in het Dublin depot, op een paar minuten afstand van de luchthaven van Dublin.  Voor degenen die graag een romantische reis willen maken langs de Wild Atlantic Way, is ‘ [Aero](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/2-person-aero/)’ of ‘Aero Plus’ de perfecte keuze voor koppels. De ‘ [Nomad](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/nomad)’  zijn iconische Volkswagen campers voor de meest nostalgische wereldreizigers. De luxe ‘ [VistaPlus](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/4-person-motorhome-vistaplus/)’ of ‘ [Grande](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/grande)’ bieden ruimte en comfort voor families en groepen.

Met jouw huis op je rug waan je je in de westkust van Ierland en ontdek het adembenemende landschap langs de Wild Atlantic Way. **Van Noord tot Zuid en van kust tot kasteel, hier zijn onze zeven bestemmingen die je gezien moet hebben**:

- # 1\. Connemara: 2000 hectare heuvels, veengebieden en prachtige bossen

![Wicklow](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/wicklow-crop-150x150.jpg)
Haal jouw camper van Bunk Campers op in het Dublin depot, op een paar minuten afstand van de luchthaven, en ga in westelijke richting naar Connemara National Park. Besteed een avontuurlijke dag omringd door **bergen**, **meren**, **grasslands**, **moerassen** en uniek **flora en fauna**. Het park biedt activiteiten die bij allerlei soorten bezoekers passen, variërend van wandelen in **Diamond Hill** tot het paardrijden op een inheemse **Connemara pony**.

- # 2\. Galway: Welkom in het meest authentieke stukje Ireland

![Galway](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/galway-150x150.jpg)
Ga zuidwaarts met jouw camper richting Galway en ontdek de authenticiteit van Ierland. Proef een Guinness in een van de **lokale pubs** terwijl je luistert naar live **Ierse folkmuziek**. Een genot voor de zintuigen. Na een geweldige avond uit kom je terug bij je camper en gaat het plezier verder: speel **spelletjes in jouw camper**, kook een **nachtelijke snack** of kijk een **film in de late avond** met een draagbare DVD-speler of surf op het internet met onze **wifi optie** aan boord. Voor de moedige mensen geldt de vraag, waarom zou je niet de Ierse **bodhran** bespelen die je misschien in de souvenierwinkel hebt gekocht?

- # 3\. Kliffen van Moher: de wildste kustlijn in Smaragden Eiland (Emerald Isle)

![Cliffs of Moher](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/moher-150x150.jpg)
Bij de Kliffen van Moher parkeer je jouw camper en loop je rondom het schitterende pad langs de kust. Wordt een bevoorrechte getuige bij een adembenemend **gevecht tussen de zee en de rotsen**. Kook ’s avonds aan boord van je camper en dineer met het **geluid van het ruisen van de branding** **als achtergrondmuziek**. En daar is alles mee gezegd.

- # 4\. Clare en Limerick: een warme sfeer in betoverende dorpen

![Adare](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/adare-1-150x150.jpg)
Terwijl je in de provincies Clare en Limerick bent, beleef je een van de meest traditionele Ierse dorpen van Ierland: rijd door Liscannor, Ennistymon of Adare, bekend staand om hun **huizen met een strodak**. Geniet van **verse plaatselijke zeevruchten**, traditionele **Ierse boxty,** een **pint met de lokale bevolking** en de warme **Ierse sfeer**.

- # 5\. Dingle: Een paradijs voor natuurliefhebbers

![Dingle](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/dingle-150x150.jpg)
Als je verder zuidwaarts gaat langs de Wild Atlantic Way, bereik je het meest westelijke punt van Europa langs het Dingle Schiereiland. Met verscheidene caravan- en kampeerplaatsen om je camper achter te laten is deze regio een paradijs voor mensen die houden van **wandelen**, **fietsen** of **vissen**. De **walvissen** en de **lokale dolfijn**, Fungie, zullen zowel kinderen als volwassenen vermaken.

- # 6\. De Ring van Kerry: waanzinnige uitzichten die je nooit zal vergeten

![Kerry](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/kerry-150x150.jpg)
De Ring van Kerry is een van de meest **schilderachtige tochten** in de wereld. Volg deze route tegen de klok in en ontdek kastelen, watervallen, forten of ongerepte stranden onderweg. Vergeet niet om te rijden naar de **Geokaun Berg**, maak een warme kop thee in je camper, wikkel jezelf in een deken en ontsnap van de wereld door te staren naar de **spectaculaire uitzichten** van een van de meest hoge punten bij de Ring van Kerry.

- # 7\. De kastelen van Cork: een reis door de tijd

![Castle Cork](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/castle-150x150.jpg)
Uiteindelijk, terwijl je op de terugweg bent naar het Bunk Campers’ depot in Dublin, neem je een stap terug in de tijd met de **middeleeuwse kastelen** in Cork. Geleid door Blarney Castle (thuis van de beroemde “ **Stone of Eloquence**”), maar andere namen zoals Carrigadrohid, Mallow of Castlemartyr zijn ook de moeite waard om te verkennen.

Tijdens het rijden langs Wild Atlantic Way zal je vele magische momenten tegen komen, maar ook mythes en bezieling. Plan jouw eigen avontuur en **laat jouw camper de weg leiden** naar de meest verre dorpen en adembenemende landschappen.


# Waarom Bunk Campers?

Bunk Campers heeft een groot wagenpark voor campers beschikbaar, aansluitbaar op alle wensen en budgetten, bij onze [Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin) en [Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/%22%20%5Ct%20%22_blank) depots.

Huur een camper in Ierland en ondervind een tour langs de Wild Atlantic Way vanaf maar £65/€70 per nacht voor 2 personen! Een uitstekende prijs versus een huurauto en B&B!

Voor verdere informatie en om reservering te maken, vul dan het contactformulier in of gebruik de online reserveringsmodule. Vergeet niet om Bunk Campers te volgen op [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/BunkCampers1) en [Twitter](https://twitter.com/bunkcampers) om op de hoogte te zijn van de laatste aanbiedingen, reisroutes en tips!

# Campervan and motorhome hire at Bunk Campers

Established in 2007, Bunk Campers are one of the UK & Ireland’s leading campervan and motorhome hire companies.

We’re all about driving adventure, so rest assured you will receive a modern, clean and well maintained campervan or motorhome. All of our vehicles for hire offer practical style and comfort, whether you are enjoying a short family holiday or a longer road trip.

Enjoy the freedom and flexibility to explore the UK & Ireland at your own pace, wake up to the best views, stop, shop and cook along the way.

For [**campervan & motorhome hire in Scotland**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/), our depot is located 10 minutes from **Edinburgh** airport and 50 minutes from Glasgow International Airport.

For [**Ireland campervan hire**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/), we are the only company with depots in both [**Dublin**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/) & [**Belfast**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/).

Offering easy access to **[England](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/),** we have a motorhome rental depot in Greater [**London**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/) offering an excellent starting point for an English motorhome adventure.

## We know a thing or three about driving value.

Camperco are one of the largest buyers of campervans and motorhomes in the UK & Ireland. As part of our group of companies in the motorhome industry, we are proud to own and operate Bunk Campers. Established 10 years ago, it has grown to be the largest independently owned rental company in the market. Part of the Knaus Tabbert Group, Weinsberg have been building motorhomes for over 45 years and are a leading brand in the European Motorhome market.

Not looking for a Motorhome? We also sell a large range of ex rental Volkswagen campervans that we build at our sister company Nomad Campervans.

At Camperco, our scale means that we can drive value in the marketplace by o­ffering great value on new and ex-rental motorhomes and campervans. Our investment in our fleet means that we know a thing or three about driving value.

## Wales

# Wales Motorhome hire

Dreaming of a motorhome holiday in Wales? Campervan and motorhome hire in Wales is the best way to explore everything this beautiful region of the UK has to offer. Collect your campervan or motorhome from our **[Greater London depot](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/)** and start your motorhome road trip to Wales.

Wales was voted one of the top regions to visit in 2017 by the Lonely Planet. With rugged coastlines, beautiful mountains and endless adventure, Wales is the perfect place for a campervan trip. Climb Snowdon, the highest mountain in Wales at Snowdonia National Park, visit the beautiful seaside town of Aberystwyth, or explore Pembrokeshire Coast National Park, the only coastal National Park in the UK at your own pace with Wales campervan rental. Stop at local campsites and enjoy the freedom and flexibility of campervan hire in Wales with Bunk Campers.

Hit the open road for an adventure of a lifetime in Wales, get your hiking boots on and discover the beauty of Brecon Beacons, learn the history of Conwy Castle and try some authentic Welsh Rarebit, Welsh cheese and Glamorgan sausages.

- ![Anglesey](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Anglesey.jpg)



###### Snowdon



The highest peak in Wales at over 1,000m tall. To climb Snowdon takes at least 6 – 8 hours and is by no means an easy walk – be warned!

- ![Llandundo](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Llandundo.jpg)



###### Llandundo



Home to 2 award-winning beaches, this coastal town in North Wales has glorious views, nature, castles and everything else you could want in a seaside stay.

- ![Portmeirion](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Portmeirion.jpg)



###### Portmeirion



This is a tourist village in North Wales, created in the fashion of an Italian style village. An enchanted stop which can be a great day trip for you and the family.

- ![Anglesey](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Anglesey.jpg)



###### Anglesey



An island off the northwest coast, accessed by a suspension bridge. Much of the island is declared an area of outstanding natural beauty so go at your own pace.

- ![pembrokeshire coast](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Tenby.jpg)



###### Tenby



This harbour town is located in a stunning area of Pembrokeshire. A Welsh holidaymakers favourite spot for centuries.

- ![Llangollen](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Llangollen.jpg)



###### Llangollen



Llangollen is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site, this town and situated alongside the River Dee is another Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty.


- ![welsh rarebit](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/welsh-rarebit.jpg)



###### Welsh Rarebit



A local delicacy, consisting of hot cheese sauce served on toasted bread.

- ![Welsh Cake](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/welsh-cake.jpg)



###### Welsh Cake



A traditional sweet bread. Served hot or cold you can add butter, jam or just eat them as they are.

- ![Glamorgan Sausages](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Glamorgan-Sausages.jpg)



###### Glamorgan Sausages



A traditional vegetarian sausage consisting of cheese, breadcrumbs and leeks.

- ![welsh cheese](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Welsh-Cheese.jpg)



###### Welsh Cheese



Hard, crumbly, white cheese that is thought to have been created to provide food for local miners.

- ![Conwy Mussels](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Conwy-Mussels.jpg)



###### Conwy Mussels



Sustainably caught mussels with a striking appearance from their colourful shells and tasty meat inside.


- ![Home farm](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-1.jpg)



###### Three Cliffs Bay



This 5-star holiday park offers luxury camping and touring pitches for campervans and motorhomes.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-2.jpg)



###### Little Kings Park



A wonderful camping meadow with high standard facilities for your holiday escape.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-3.jpg)



###### Morawelon Camping and Caravanning



A beautiful, picturesque family-run campsite with a seafront location.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-4.jpg)



###### Trevayne Farm



Nestled between Tenby and Saundersfoot, this stunning campsite is on a beautiful farm.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-5.jpg)



###### Abercastle



Abercastle Campsite is surrounded by stunning scenery and a plethora of wildlife habitats. It’s a dog-friendly site and dogs are very welcome.

- ![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/campsite-6.jpg)



###### Trellyn Woodland Camping



Ideally located on the Pembroke Peninsula and only a short walk to Abercastle Bay. Trellyn is surrounded by stunning coastland countryside.

- ![zipworld](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/zipworld.jpg)



###### Zipworld



A completely unique range of special activities including Europe’s longest ziplines, underground trampolines and high-rope adventures.

- ![Elan Valley Reservoirs](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Elan-Valley-Reservoirs.jpg)



###### Elan Valley Reservoirs



A chain of man made lakes has been inspiring visitors for decades. Beautiful scenery and an abundance of walking trails make this a great escape.

- ![Bike Park Wales](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Bike-Park-Wales.jpg)



###### Bike Park Wales



A home for thrill seekers in this mountain bikers paradise. From novice to professionals, there is a trail here for everyone.

- ![Gower Peninsula](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Gower-Peninsula.jpg)



###### Gower Peninsula



Woodlands, cliffs and sandy beaches. Loved by surfers, walkers, birdwatchers and holidaymakers – and with good reason.

- ![Pembrokeshire Coast](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Pembrokeshire-Coast.jpg)



###### Pembrokeshire Coast



Infamous for islands, array of wildlife and steep cliffs, Pembrokeshire is the only coastal national park in the UK. See why for yourself.


- ![Gavin and Stacey Tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/gavin-and-stacey-tour.jpg)



###### Gavin and Stacey Tour



A 3-hour tour covering many of the key locations, watch key clips and enjoy the fun with other fans of the hit BBC TV show.

- ![Canoe Aqueduct Tours Llangollen](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Canoe-Aqueduct-Tours-Llangollen.jpg)



###### Canoe Aqueduct Tours Llangollen



Embrace the scenery by canoe, paddling through the beautiful Dee Valley. Take a relaxing canoe journey, suitable for experienced paddlers and beginners alike.

- ![Hop-on Hop-off Cardiff Tour](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Hop-on-Hop-off.jpg)



###### Hop-on Hop-off Cardiff Tour



Discover Cardiff with the classic red open top bus and see all the major attractions without needing to drive your campervan hire everywhere.


- ![Whitewater Rafting Llangollen](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Whitewater-Rafting.jpg)



###### Whitewater Rafting Llangollen



Known as one of the best rivers in the UK to white water raft, these rapids have different levels of thrills for you. A real river journey for everyone – including kids!

- ![Coasteering Wales](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Coasteering-Wales.jpg)



###### Coasteering Wales



From beginning in Pembrokeshire, this has spread down the Welsh coast. There are plenty of locations to get into a wetsuit and go head first into the Irish channel with other thrillseekers.

- ![pembrokeshire coast](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Tenby.jpg)



###### Pembrokeshire Coast National Park



240 square miles of the UK’s only coastal national park. The perfect place to explore in your motorhome hire with endless opportunities to explore the outdoors, beaches, cliffs and wildlife.

- ![Caernarfon Castle](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Caernarfon-Castle.jpg)



###### Caernarfon Castle



A must-see on your trip to Wales. Part of the World Heritage Site, this was one of the greatest buildings of the Middle Ages. You won’t want to miss this.


- ![The Coastal Way](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/The-Coastal-Way.jpg)



###### The Coastal Way



This 180-mile road trip spans the entire length of Cardigan Bay in West Wales, embracing the stunning scenery on offer. Get in your Welsh campervan rental and enjoy the Pembrokeshire Coast Path, Snowdonia and the Isle of Anglesey.

- ![The Cambrian Way](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/The-Cambrian-Way.jpg)



###### The Cambrian Way



A spectacular 298-mile,  spectacular, north-south road trip through the spine of Wales. Travelling from coast to coast, some stops include Snowdonia, Brecon Beacons and Llandudno. Hit this road trip with your Welsh campervan hire.

- ![The North Wales Way](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/The-North-Wales-Way.jpg)



###### The North Wales Way



This 75-mile road trip follows an old trading route through the northern coast into Anglesey. The route includes Harlech, a 13th-century fortress and a UNESCO World Heritage site, Caernarfon and much more.

- ![South Wales Circuit](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/South-Wales-Circuit.jpg)



###### South Wales Circuit



If you want a bit of everything, this is the road trip for you. From Cardiff to Chepstow, this 333-mile route includes jaw-dropping beaches, rugged cliffs, and culture-filled cities. Perfect for campervan hire!

#### **Wales Motorhome Hire FAQs**

- [**Can I hire a motorhome at 70 years old?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/motorhome-hire-wales/#)


Drivers aged 21-79 years can hire a campervan or motorhome in Wales with Bunk Campers provided they meet the usual driving licence criteria outlined in our terms and conditions.

- [**Can you park a motorhome in Wales?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/motorhome-hire-wales/#)


Wild camping is only legal in England and Wales if you have been granted permission by the landowner and every bit of land is owned by a private individual.



The National Parks Authority forbid wild camping within any National Parks of England and Wales



At Bunk Campers we advise that all our guests stay in campsites during their motorhome hire, to plug in their motorhome into mains electricity, recharge the batteries, and benefit from the campsite facilities.

- [**What’s included with my Bunk Camper rental?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/motorhome-hire-wales/#)


All rentals include unlimited mileage/ KMs, driver insurance, vehicle & roadside assistance, comprehensive vehicle handover, discounted ferries, up to 30% off the UK Camping and Caravan Club, kitchen kit and many more. View our full list of what’s included [here](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/motorhome-hire-inventory/).

- [**Can you drive a motorhome on a normal licence?**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/motorhome-hire-wales/#)


At Bunk Campers, all our campervans and motorhome for hire are under 3500kg so can be driven with a normal ‘B’ car driving licence.

# Motorhome & Campervan Hire Yorkshire (Leeds)

Thinking about motorhome hire in Yorkshire? Pick up from any of [Bunk Campers UK motorhome hire depots](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/) and travel to everything Leeds, Yorkshire & the Lake District has to offer!

With spectacular mountains, valleys, villages, towns, coastline and of course lakes, Northern England is a nature lover’s paradise. Packed with **National Parks**, outdoor activities and breathtaking views, the opportunities to get out and explore are endless.

With transport and accommodation in one, campervan hire offers access and connectivity to all Northern England has to offer.

We have [campervans and motorhomes to suit all budgets](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/). So whether it’s a budget weekend away, a rambling holiday through the Pennines or **great family escape in the Lake District**, we have a campervan for you.

### Our range of campervans and motorhomes for hire are ideal for couples, friends and groups who want comfort on their camping holiday.

All of our campervans and motorhomes for hire are less than 3 years old and come equipped with GPS & reversing camera. When you hire a campervan to go around Leeds from Bunk Campers, you also have the choice of hireable extras to make your holiday as comfortable as possible. From outdoor tables and chairs or even an extra pillow – we have it covered.

![Birmingham](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/Birmingham-mobile-150x150.jpg)

For something easy to drive, the **[Aero](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/2-person-aero/ "2 person motorhome hire Dublin")** is the perfect choice for couples wanting a compact camper that doesn’t compromise on facilities. The Aero is equipped with a bright, modern interior including shower, toilet and fixed rear bed. For apartment style living on the road, the [**Aero Plus**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/2-person-motorhome-aeroplus/) is an elegant and dynamic low profile motorhome offering space and comfort for couples touring.

For families on a budget, the **[Vista](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/4-person-campervan-hire-vista/ "4 person campervan hire Dublin")** sleeps up to 4 people and makes clever use of storage to pack in a full range of facilities into a compact vehicle. For extra space and comfort, the **[Vista Plus](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/4-person-motorhome-vistaplus/ "4 person motorhome hire Dublin")** with overhead cab comes equipped with 2 fixed double beds, spacious lounge and large garage storage for all of your equipment. Large families or groups of friends can enjoy will the **[Grande](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/grande/ "6 person motorhome hire Dublin")** which offers maximum space and comfort for up to 6 people.

**Not sure what to choose? For more information, [contact us](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) and a member of our team will be happy to assist with a personalised quotation.**

# What’s Included?

![Bunk Campers rental](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Bunk-Campers-rental.jpg)

Your Bunk Campers rental includes everything you need for the perfect campervan or motorhome holiday. From campsite discounts, a full kitchen area, a kitchen kit with cooking utensils, and so much more, your rental is transformed into your very own home on wheels. Live happily in your Bunk Camper and enjoy easy access to all the essentials to keep your motorhome cosy and clean. Discover what’s included with your Bunk Campers campervan hire.

All our vehicles come fully equipped with the following items to make life easy on the open road. With a list so comprehensive you will never want to leave your holiday bubble.

* * *

## All Rentals Include:

- Unlimited Mileage/KMs
- [Comprehensive UK insurance for 1 driver](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/licences-and-restrictions/)
- Vehicle & roadside assistance
- Vehicle handover
- [Discounted ferry crossings](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/ferry-crossings/) (in partnership with the Caravan and Motorhome Club)
- UK & Ireland campsite guides and discounts
- Free linen exchange at depots
- Free Harlington station transfer for Toddington Rentals
- 24/7 roadside assistance
- thl On the Road Support

* * *

## Driver’s cab inventory

![Driver's cab](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Whats-included-in-the-camper.jpg)

- Vehicle Manual
- Radio
- Blinds/Privacy Screens
- Reversing Camera
- GPS connectivity (Built in Sat Nav, Apple maps or Android Auto).
- USB/12V Sockets

* * *

## Living Area Inventory

![living room](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/living-room.jpg)

- Fridge
- Sink
- 2-3 burner gas hob(s) for cooking
- 240V & 12V Sockets
- Dining Table
- Toilet and hot water shower
- Heating and hot water
- Oven/Grill (except Areo & Vista)

* * *

## Kitchen Kit Inventory

![](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Bunk_Campers_Europa_UK_IE_Kitchen_1.jpg)

- Kettle
- Knives
- Forks
- Spoons
- Teaspoons
- 2 Sharp knives
- Ladle (large spoon)
- Slotted spoon
- Fish slice
- Potato masher
- Chopping board
- Colander
- Tin opener
- Corkscrew/bottle opener
- Vegetable peeler
- Dinner plates
- Side plates
- Bowls
- Plastic tumblers
- Mugs
- 3 pots (small, medium & large)
- Frying pan
- Scissors

## Back/Garage Inventory

![Garage & back](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Garage-back.jpg)

- Gas Cylinder or LPS gas for cooking and/or heating (gas is at the guest’s expense)
- 2 gas adapters cabled tied to gas bottle
- Electric hookup cable
- Fresh water filling hose
- Hose connector
- Tap connector
- Sweeping brush, dustpan and brush

* * *

## Safety Equipment

- Fire Extinguisher
- CO alarm
- Smoke alarm

* * *

## Emergency Kit

- Tyre inflation kit/spare tyre
- Warning Traingle
- High vis vests (1 per person)
- Towing eye
- Locking wheel nut
- Spare bulbs and fuse pack
- Beam benders

* * *

![Bunk Campers Motorhome Parked at a Campsite](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Campsite-1.png)

## Bunk Campers & Tourism Ireland Exklusiv: Gewinnen Sie eine 5-Nächte-Reise mit einem Wohnmobil

# Gewinnen Sie eine Wohnmobilmiete für 5 Nächte, um Irland zu erkunden

Träumen Sie davon, Irland zu erkunden? Bunk Campers, Irlands größter Wohnmobilvermieter, hat sich mit Tourism Ireland zusammengetan, um Ihnen die Chance zu bieten, den Wohnmobil-Roadtrip Ihres Lebens zu gewinnen!

Machen Sie sich auf den Weg und entdecken Sie atemberaubende Landschaften hinter jeder Ecke. Von den Küsten und Klippen entlang des Wild Atlantic Way bis zu den Mythen und Legenden der Causeway Coastal Route, Irlands altem Osten oder den Hidden Heartlands – wohin Sie fahren, entscheiden Sie!

Machen Sie einfach unten mit, um zu gewinnen!

* * *

```

404 Page Not Found



		404 Page Not Found
		The page you requested was not found.

```

Der Gewinner wird am 6. Februar 2023 ermittelt. Alle Details zum Preis weiter unten.

**Gewinnen Sie eine Wohnmobilmiete für 5 Nächte, um Irland zu erkunden**

## Details zum Gewinn:

- 5 Nächte Wohnmobilmiete des Aero Plus, Vista Plus, Europa oder Grande Wohnmobils für bis zu 4 Personen mit freundlicher Genehmigung von Bunk Campers
- Abholung und Rückgabe an den Stationen von Bunk Campers in [Belfast](https://bunkcampers.com/belfast/) und [Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/dublin/)
- Versicherung für einen Fahrer im Alter von 21 bis 80 Jahren im Besitz eines vollwertigen Führerschein seit mehr als 2 Jahren.
- Unbegrenzte Kilometer.
- Küchenausstattung und Wasserkocher.
- Fahrzeug- und Pannenhilfe
- Reisezeitraum: 13. Februar – 30. Dezember 2023 (ausgenommen 1. Juni – 30. September und vorbehaltlich Verfügbarkeit)

### **Was nicht inbegriffen ist:**

- Flüge oder Transport nach/von Irland
- Kaution für das Wohnmobil
- Kraftstoff
- Campingplatzgebühren
- Geldausgaben

* * *

### **Geschäftsbedingungen:**

- Es gelten die allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen von _Bunk Campers._
- _Automatisierte Beiträge oder Beiträge Dritter werden disqualifiziert._
- _Der Gewinner wird per E-Mail benachrichtigt und auf unserer Webseite und in den sozialen Medien veröffentlicht._
- _Bunk Campers geht mit dem Datenschutzgesetz konform. Unsere Richtlinie ist, dass wir Ihre Daten nicht ohne Ihre vorherige Zustimmung an Dritte weitergeben._
- _Der Gewinn kann nicht in bar ausgezahlt werden._
- _Die vollständigen Wettbewerbsbedingungen können [hier eingesehen werden.](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Rules-and-regs.pdf)_

## We know a thing or three about driving value.

Camperco are one of the largest buyers of campervans and motorhomes in the UK & Ireland. As part of our group of companies in the motorhome industry, we are proud to own and operate Bunk Campers. Established 10 years ago, it has grown to be the largest independently owned rental company in the market. We are the only authorised rental partner of Weinsberg motorhomes in the UK and their exclusive retail partner in the South East of England, Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland.

We focus on retailing and renting Weinsberg motorhomes. Why? They cleverly deliver value and affordability with their smart German design, innovation and build quality. Part of the Knaus Tabbert Group, Weinsberg have been building motorhomes for over 45 years and are a leading brand in the European Motorhome market.

Not looking for a Motorhome? We also sell a large range of ex rental Volkswagen campervans that we build at our sister company Nomad Campervans.

At Camperco, our scale means that we can drive value in the marketplace by o­ffering great value on new and ex-rental motorhomes and campervans. Our investment in our fleet means that we know a thing or three about driving value.

**Campervans and motorhomes are our business. We hire them, we convert them, we sell them and we equip them.**

# 10 Day Heart of England Driving Route: Discover Castles, Royalty & Shakespeare in the English Midlands

Whether it’s the heritage and culture of **Shakespeare’s England** and the quintessentially British villages and towns, or the dramatic landscapes of **Oxford** and **Shropshire**, there’s plenty to see and do! Campervan rental from our **[Birmingham](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/motorhome-hire-birmingham/) depot** is the perfect departure point to visit all the **Heartland of England** has to offer!

- # Day 1: Park Up & Enjoy


16 mi / 25 km
![Aero](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/DSC_9683-150x150.jpg)
Pick up your camper from Bunk Campers Birmingham depot from 15:00.

Drive to the **Kingsbury Water Park Club** campsite just 25 minutes away from the depot. Bordered by the lovely Water Park, this campsite is the perfect setting for a leisurely break. It’s a spacious site with large, level pitches and modern facilities which benefit from underfloor heating.

- # Days 2: Shakespeare's England


59 mi / 94km
![castle](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/img_0517-150x150.jpg)
Home to world famous attractions including the **Royal Shakespeare Company**, **Warwick Castle** and **Shakespeare’s Birthplace** this is where history and heritage come to life. This idyllic destination encompasses South Warwickshire, parts of the Cotswolds and some of England’s most famous towns.



**Kenilworth Castle & Elizabethan Garden** Kenilworth is best known as the home of **Robert Dudley**, the great love of **Queen Elizabeth I**. Once boasting the finest architecture in Elizabethan England, you can still imagine the **ornate palace** Dudley created for his Queen in Kenilworth’s magnificent ruins today. The authentically recreated Elizabethan Garden really brings this romantic royal story to life.

**Warwick Castle** Dating back to **914**, Warwick Castle has stood as an impressive **Medieval Fortress** on the banks of the river Avon for the last 1100 years. The castle has survived the changing fortunes of history and remains one of the most well-preserved Medieval castles in the UK.

**Stratford-upon-Avon – Shakespeare’s Birthplace & New Place** Walk in Shakespeare’s footsteps and explore the house where he was born and grew up then take a visit to the site of William Shakespeare’s grand family home, now a **heritage landmark** where visitors can connect with the playwright on the very ground where he lived for almost 20 years.

**Chipping Norton Camping and Caravanning Club Site**


Tucked away off the beaten track, this campsite offers a mix of level and sloping pitches, surrounded by trees and dry-stone walls perfect for a break from a busy day of sight-seeing, cooking dinner with the **convenient gas hob**.

- # Day 3: Animal Kingdom in the Cotswolds


58 mi / 93km
![Ranger & highland cow](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/DenisCebulec-4-150x150.jpg)
**Cotswold Wildlife Park and Gardens**


After a relaxing breakfast, visit one of the **UK’s largest zoological collections** and most exciting gardens set in the picturesque backdrop of the Costwolds.

**Chipping Norton Camping and Caravanning Club Site**


Return to Chipping Norton where you can relax with a hot beverage from our **welcome kit** and peruse the photos and selfies with your new animal friends from the exciting visit to the Wildlife Park!

- # Day 4: Royalty, Regalia & Religion


22.5 mi / 36 km
![Viaggi-di-rospi-5](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/03/Viaggi-di-rospi-5-150x150.jpg)


**Blenheim Palace**


Blenheim Palace is a monumental English country house and the principal residence of the **Dukes of Marlborough**. The palace, one of England’s largest houses, was built between 1705 and circa 1722 and designated a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** in 1987.

**Christ Church, Oxford**


Christ Church is located in the heart of the city centre and is one of the colleges belonging to the **University of Oxford**. It is also home to the legendary **Christ Church Cathedral**, which was built in the 12th century. Today, Christ Church is a visitor favourite, well-known for its impressive architecture, entertaining evening choirs and the **War Memorial Garden**.

**Oxford Camping and Caravanning Club Site**


This site is very close to Oxford city, yet its **restful ambience** makes it ideal to kick back and relax after a day visiting Oxford. Trees line this well laid out site, pitches are level and the site is well equipped with a range of facilities. Take a walk into Oxford town to soak up some of this historic university town’s culture.

- # Day 5: Water Springs and Imperial Fortresses


124 mi / 200 km
![Family Grande](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/small-fam-150x143.jpg)


**Malvern Hills**


The area is famed for its dramatic hills and for the **pure spring water** that flows from them, but it offers so much more. A rich cultural heritage of **forts**, **castles** and **priories** stands proudly from this landscape of **ancient woodland**, rolling pastures and wild, open commons.

**Wolverly Camping & Caravanning Club Site**


Surrounded by the stunning **Worcestershire** countryside and with the **Staffordshire** and Worcestershire canal just 60 metres from site means you really can enjoy life in the slow lane. Cook up your evening meal and enjoy it by the riverside, relaxing under the stars.

- # Day 6: Natural Beauty and Tranquil Trails


60 mi / 97 km
![Aero campervan](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/DSC_9828-150x150.jpg)
**Shropshire Hills**


One of the first areas in the UK to be designated an **Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty** over 60 years ago. Off the beaten track and tranquil, this is a living, working place, loved by locals and visitors alike for its quality of environment, for **walking** and **activities**, **relaxation** and **inspiration**.

**Oswestry, Cranberry Moss Camping & Caravanning Club Site**


Return to Oswestry and relax your feet with one of our **camping chairs**, available as a hireable extra for your camper holiday, while enjoying the **comfortable bed** at night, where you will rest peacefully ahead of your next adventure.

- # Day 7: Stalactites and Stalagmites


90 mi / 145km
![campervan hire Snowdonia](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/Snowdonia-x.jpg)
**Pooles Cavern & Buxton Country Park**


Poole’s Cavern is a **two-million-year-old natural limestone cave** on the edge of Buxton in the Peak District. Explore the vast Limestone caverns and see how crystal Stalactites and Stalagmites have lined the chambers over millions of years. Back above ground explore the beautiful country park woodlands and complete your day with a stroll to **Grin Low** and **Solomon’s Temple** viewpoint with superb views of the Peak District.

**Alton, The Star Camping & Caravanning Club Site**


The Peak District National Park is right on the doorstep of Alton, The Star Club campsite and is the perfect base camp for the Peak District.

- # Day 8 & 9: Reaching the Peak in Hope Valley


60 mi / 97km
![Scotland Vista Plus](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/16465172_856460414493824_2222377750109356032_n-1-150x150.jpg)


**Peak District National Park Castleton Visitor’s Centre**


Castleton is a beautiful village situated in the **Hope Valley**, in the heart of the Peak District National Park. Surrounded by hillsides and overlooked by **Mam Tor** (the shivering mountain) and the ancient **Peveril Castle**.

**Alton, The Star Camping & Caravanning Club Site**


Return to base camp and cook up a storm to fuel you for the climb to The Shivering Mountain. If it gets chilly, stick the heat on with our climate-controlled cabin area.

- # Day 10: Shiver Mountain


60 mil / 97 km
![North Coast 500](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/nc550-150x150.jpg)


**Mam Tor & The Shivering Mountain**


The stone surfaced footpath from the car park to the top of Mam Tor will reward you with one of the most dramatic viewpoints in the Peak District. The viewpoint at Mam Tor stretches north over the **Edale Valley** to **Kinder Scout** and the **Derwent Moors**. A circular route takes you round Mam Tor and has some amazing scenery.

**Alton, The Star Camping & Caravanning Club Site**


Return to the Star Camping & Caravanning site and enjoy the range of facilities as you relax on your final night of your campervan holiday at the foot of the Peak District.

- # Day 11: The Final Stop


59 mi / 95km
![Vista Campervan](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Vista-Web-2-150x150.jpg)


**Return to Bunk Campers Birmingham Depot**

Enjoy a relaxing breakfast before setting off for Bunk Campers Birmingham.


Bunk Campers have [**a large range of campervans for hire**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/) from our [Birmingham](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/motorhome-hire-birmingham/) depot. Choose from budget 2 person camping cars to large motorhomes for up to 6 people.

You can book directly online or for more information, fill in the form below and one of the Bunk Campers team will get back to you as soon as possible!

## We know a thing or three about driving value.

Camperco are one of the largest buyers of campervans and motorhomes in the UK & Ireland. As part of our group of companies in the motorhome industry, we are proud to own and operate Bunk Campers. Established 10 years ago, it has grown to be the largest independently owned rental company in the market. We are the only authorised rental partner of Weinsberg motorhomes in the UK and their exclusive retail partner in the South East of England, Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland.

We focus on retailing and renting Weinsberg motorhomes. Why? They cleverly deliver value and affordability with their smart German design, innovation and build quality. Part of the Knaus Tabbert Group, Weinsberg have been building motorhomes for over 45 years and are a leading brand in the European Motorhome market.

Not looking for a Motorhome? We also sell a large range of ex rental Volkswagen campervans that we build at our sister company Nomad Campervans.

At Camperco, our scale means that we can drive value in the marketplace by o­ffering great value on new and ex-rental motorhomes and campervans. Our investment in our fleet means that we know a thing or three about driving value.

**Campervans and motorhomes are our business. We hire them, we convert them, we sell them and we equip them.**

# Driver Details

Thank you for booking with Bunk Campers! We hope you are excited for your upcoming motorhome road trip.  To help get you ready for your road trip, we require some additional information which will help speed up your check in when you arrive at our depot.

Please complete your driver details and arrival information below. If you have any questions, please [contact us](https://bunkcampers.com/en/contact/) and a member of the Bunk Campers Team will be happy to assist you.

Don’t forget, **all persons wanting to drive the motorhome need to be present at check in.** All drivers need to bring all parts of their driving licence. In Northern Ireland, the counter part licence is required. For drivers holding a Mainland UK driving licence, you will need to provide access to your counterpart. You can find out more information [here](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/licences-and-restrictions/).

# Leave No Trace

![leave no trace](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/leave-no-trace-2-1.jpg)

Campervan holidays are one the UK & Ireland’s great past times. But, with 1000’s of people travelling every year, our love for the outdoors can take its toll. That’s why, we’ve adopted the “Leave No Trace” principles aimed to create sustainability in our natural environment.

* * *

## What is Leave No Trace?

“Leave No Trace” is a framework of principles and best practices aimed at minimising our impact on the environment and recommended to be used by everyone.

The Leave No Trace Center for Outdoor Ethics consider the framework to be flexible and cover a range of principles.

* * *

## The “Leave No Trace” Seven Principles

You may have already seen it before, areas of natural beauty covered with rubbish or our favourite trails run down to mud. While most of us don’t intend to do any damage to our surroundings, you may not have the knowledge to preserve it. The “Leave No Trace” principles outline the best things we can do to protect and preserve our environment. Thus, preserving a bedrock of British & Irish culture- camping & campervanning.

* * *

## 1\. Plan ahead and prepare

![plan ahead](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/plan-ahead.jpg)

It goes without saying, proper planning is an essential to the campervan and motorhome experience. Here’s our list of top things to plan for:

- **Weather conditions-** Keep an eye on the weather, and try not to travel in extreme weather conditions.
- **Timing**– Schedule ahead to avoid times of high use.
- **Keep to groups of 6 or under**– consider splitting into 2 groups if necessary.
- **Bring the right equipment**– appropriate footwear will help stop terrain damage. Other things to consider is maps, torches and water flasks.

Don’t forget to ensure your campervan is fully stocked with everything you need before you go. Find out [what’s included in your campervan](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/motorhome-hire-inventory/), read [tips on what to pack](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/holiday-checklist/)& browse optional [extras](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hireable-extras/) you can hire for the road before your go.

* * *

## 2\. Travel and camp on durable surface

Whenever possible it is best to stay on the trails that seem to be getting the most use. When exploring your surroundings and setting up for overnight camp, seek out resilient types of terrain.

Ideal durable surfaces include established trails and campsites, rock, gravel, dry grasses or snow. We recommend using campsites as much as possible during your trip and to camp well away from cliffs & lakes.

* * *

## 3\. Dispose of waste properly

![Waste disposal](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/dispose.jpg)

Anything you leave behind is likely to affect other people, water and wildlife. We have all seen pictures of nature covered in rubbish or animals trapped in plastic waste. Consider how and where you are disposing all waste. Consider how you dispose of the following:

- **Waste water / Black water / Human & pet waste**– Proper disposal of waste is necessary to avoid pollution. Campsites should have a designated area to empty waste or use public facilities where possible. Consider adding a portable toilet to your campervan hire if it doesn’t have a toilet on board.
- **Rubbish, litter & leftover food-** Take everything home, or dispose in a appropriate bin, including any biodegradable litter & leftovers.

#### [Read more about waste disposal with your campervan>](https://bunkcampers.com/waste-disposal)

* * *

## 4\. Leave what you find

That plant may look nice in your back garden, but leave it there for everyone to enjoy. Allow others a sense of discovery by leaving rocks, artifacts, plants and any other objects where you find them. Follow these rules:

- Don’t build structures, make site alterations or dig holes
- Avoid damaging plant life and don’t hang items from trees
- Leave natural objects for others to experience

* * *

## 5\. Minimize campfire impact

Campfires are a camping tradition, but they can cause lasting impressions and devastating impacts on the natural environment. Follow these rules where possible:

- Avoid having campfires unless you are confident that you can have one safely
- Use campsite facilities, fire rings or mound fires if possible
- Keep campfires small
- Extinguish campfires out completely and don’t leave them unattended
- Don’t burn plastics or anything that emits toxic fumes
- Remove all traces of campfires before you leave

Useful reading: [http://paulkirtley.co.uk/2011/how-to-leave-no-trace-of-your-campfire/](http://paulkirtley.co.uk/2011/how-to-leave-no-trace-of-your-campfire/)

* * *

## 6\. Respect wildlife

![animals](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/animals-2.jpg)

Avoid walking up to any wildlife, including farm animals like cows, sheep etc. This is their home too, so stand back and observe them from a distance. Try not to feed animals and store any rations or rubbish securely away from their reaches. Keep control of your pet or leave them at home.

* * *

## 7\. Be considerate of other visitors

The goal of Leave No Trace, is to create sustainable tourism in these areas without affecting nature. Following the principles are the best way to do this and allows every person to enjoy the same experience as you.

Don’t forget to also be considerate of others, try to be courteous, avoid loud noises, camp away from trails and above all, respect everyone’s experience.

* * *

## Bunk Campers Commitment

At Bunk Campers, we are committed to helping create sustainable tourism with our campervan and motorhome hire. We work with several partners and affiliations to bring you the latest advice and keep you right on the road.

Following this page advice will help create a sustainable environment for all campers, campervanners and tourers alike. If you have any questions or would like a quote for the road email our [customer service team](mailto:enquiries@bunkcampers.com) and we’ll be happy to assist.

# Waste Disposal

![waste disposal](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/waste-disposal.jpg)

It may be your home on wheels, but unlike houses, campervans & motorhomes have some additional disposal needs. It is not the most glam topic, but all waste has the potential to pollute the environment if you do not handle or store it properly. To help you on your trip, we have provided some guidance on responsible waste disposal.

* * *

## General Waste- Litter- Recycling

One of the big benefits of campervanning is the ability to get away from it all. However, once you are in those areas, remember it’s somebody else’s home. Whether it’s animals, plant life, locals in the area, or even other campervanners touring just like you, it’s important to respect the environment. If you are unsure, familiarise yourself with the [“leave no trace” principles](https://bunkcampers.com/leave-no-trace) to keep right.

Perhaps a good general rule while in your motorhome is to treat it like your house. You should separate waste and recyclable material where possible. Make sure to store waste materials safely and securely so litter doesn’t scatter. Campsites should provide recycling areas, or most supermarkets have an area to recycle goods. If there is nowhere to dispose of litter, try to hold on to this until you can find an appropriate place.

### Here is a reminder on recyclable waste:

### Recycled  Waste

- Paper & cardboard
- Glass bottles
- Plastic bottles
- Food tins and drinks
- Magazines

### Compost  (If Applicable)

- Food waste
- Pizza boxes
- Teabags and coffee grounds
- Egg shells
- Fruit & vegetable peelings

### General  Waste

- Nappies
- Plastic cutlery
- Styrofoam containers & snack wrappers
- Plastic bags
- Broken glass

* * *

## Fresh Water

All our campervans have a freshwater tank. For practical reasons, it’s important to keep an eye on fresh water supply. You’d be surprised how much water you might use whether for tea, drinking, shower, toilet or any other reason.

When filling up, make sure your water supply is safe to drink. Campsites should have a place signposted where you can fill up.

All Bunk Campers rentals are supplied with a food grade hose and demonstration of how to use this.  Reusable water containers are also a good and environmentally friendly way to keep stocked up on the road.

* * *

## Grey Waste Water

![waste water](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/waste-water.jpg)

Grey water refers to water that goes down your sink or shower and collects in an on board waste water tank.

It’s a good idea to empty this as much as possible, because left to build up and stand can cause odours to develop. Due to the chemicals that go into this such as washing up liquid, shower gel and toothpaste, you need to be careful about emptying this in the correct place. The best way to keep right, is to only empty at campsite disposal areas. This way, it’ll go into the sewage system for treatment.

If they don’t have an area to empty this, ask the campsite owners as they may use this for hedgerows.

Here are some tips to help avoid odour build ups:

- Empty your waste tank in designated areas when possible.
- Scrape dishes and pans before washing to remove as much residue as possible.

* * *

## Black Waste Water or Chemical Toilet Waste

Black water refers to waste water from toilets which will contain harmful bacteria and should **only** be emptied at the designated areas.

You can find chemical toilet waste or black water waste emptying points at campsites or service points called a Chemical Disposal Point (CDP), Elsan disposal point or Black waste disposal point.

In your motorhome hire, the vehicle should include a cassette toilet which can be removed and wheeled to the disposal point. You can add eco-friendly toilet tabs as a [hireable extra](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hireable-extras/) to assist with cleaning this.

In a VW campervan hire, you can add a portable toilet to your hire and follow the same rules for emptying this at you would the cassette toilet.

**Never** dispose of chemical toilet waste into a watercourse, surface drain, the ground or groundwater.

* * *

## Pet Waste

![pet](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/pet.jpg)

Picking up dog poo may not be pleasant, but it is definitely a necessity. Pet waste is actually bad for the environment and does not act as a fertiliser like other animals. It’s important to clear up after your pet when you are on your campervan hire holiday. Just remember to bag it and bin it!

* * *

## Some additional reading

#### [Campa Waste Disposal Advice](https://www.campa.org.uk/waste-disposal/) (Waste Disposal in Scotland)

#### [Caravan and Camping Club: Water & Waste](https://www.campingandcaravanningclub.co.uk/helpandadvice/gettingstarted/campingequipment/waterandwaste/)

There’s never been a better time to explore Scotland, Ireland, England, Northern Ireland, or all four in one trip! With our incredible off season prices, plus this **exclusive 15% saving** on the nightly rental rate, you’ll be able to drive further or stay longer for less.

Pick up your campervan or motorhome in one of our gateway locations: **[London](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/england/london/), [Edinburgh](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/scotland/edinburgh/), [Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/)** or [**Belfast**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/) and set off wherever you please with your transport and accommodation in one.

Simply choose the Bunk Camper that best suits you from [**our wide range of modern vehicle types**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/). From compact campervans to large motorhomes for families and groups of friends, we have something to suit everyone.

Soak up the autumn colours, enjoy a winter adventure or look forward to a spring break. **With rates from as low as £55/€60 per night**, popular dates are selling out fast – early booking is advised to avoid disappointment!

# Cookie Policy

Updated 4 March 2024

[Download thl Cookie Policy](https://thl.widen.net/content/cww8ntbb5h/pdf/Cookie-Policy-Feb-2024.pdf)

* * *

1.

## INTRODUCTION

This is the Cookie Policy for Tourism Holdings Limited thl

* * *

2.

## WHAT ARE COOKIES?

2.1

As is common practice with almost all professional websites our websites use cookies,
which are tiny files that are downloaded to your computer, to improve your experience.
This page describes what information they gather, how we use it, and why we
sometimes need to store these cookies. We will also share how you can prevent these
cookies from being stored however this may downgrade or 'break' certain elements of
the site's functionality.

* * *

3.

## HOW WE USE COOKIES

3.1

We use cookies for a variety of reasons detailed below. Unfortunately, in most cases
there are no industry standard options for disabling cookies without completely
disabling the functionality and features they add to this site. It is recommended that you
leave on all cookies if you are not sure whether you need them or not in case, they are
used to provide a service that you use.

* * *

4.

## DISABLING COOKIES

4.1

You can prevent the setting of cookies by adjusting the settings on your browser (see
your browser Help for how to do this). Be aware that disabling cookies will affect the
functionality of this and many other websites that you visit. Disabling cookies will usually
result in also disabling certain functionality and features of this site. Therefore, it is
recommended that you do not disable cookies.

* * *

5.

## THE COOKIES WE SET

5.1

### Email newsletters related cookies

This site offers newsletter or email subscription services and cookies may be used to
remember if you are already registered and whether to show certain notifications which
might only be valid to subscribed/unsubscribed users.

5.2

### Forms related cookies

When you submit data to through a form such as those found on contact pages or
comment forms cookies may be set to remember your user details for future
correspondence.

5.3

### Site preferences cookies

To provide you with a great experience on this site we provide the functionality to set
your preferences for how this site runs when you use it. To remember your preferences,
we need to set cookies so that this information can be called whenever you interact with
a page that is affected by your preferences.

* * *

6.

## THIRD PARTY COOKIES

In some special cases we also use cookies provided by trusted third parties. The following
section details which third party cookies you might encounter through this site.

6.1

Our sites use Google Analytics which is one of the most widespread and trusted analytics
solutions on the web to help us understand how you use the site and ways that we can
improve your experience. These cookies may track things such as how long you spend on
the site and the pages that you visit so we can continue to produce engaging content.

For more information on Google Analytics cookies, [see the official Google Analytics\\
page](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies?hl=en-US).

6.2

Third party analytics are used to track and measure usage of this site so that we can
continue to produce engaging content. These cookies may track things such as how long
you spend on the site or pages you visit which helps us to understand how we can
improve the site for you.

6.3

From time to time, we test new features and make subtle changes to the way that the
site is delivered. When we are still testing new features, these cookies may be used to
ensure that you receive a consistent experience whilst on the site whilst ensuring we
understand which optimisations our users appreciate the most.

6.4

As we sell products it's important for us to understand statistics about how many of the
visitors to our site make a purchase and as such this is the kind of data that these
cookies will track. This is important to you as it means that we can accurately make
business predictions that allow us to monitor our advertising and product costs to
ensure the best possible price.

6.5

The behavioural advertising cookies used by this site are designed to ensure that we
provide you with the most relevant adverts where possible by anonymously tracking
your interests and presenting similar things that may be of interest.

6.6

We also use social media buttons and/or plugins on this site that allow you to connect
with your social network in various ways. For these to work the following social media
sites including; Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and X, will set cookies through our site
which may be used to enhance your profile on their site or contribute to the data they
hold for various purposes outlined in their respective privacy policies.

* * *

7.

## MORE INFORMATION

7.1

Hopefully that has clarified things for you and as was previously mentioned if there is
something that you aren't sure whether you need or not it's usually safer to leave
cookies enabled in case it does interact with one of the features you use on our site.

7.2

However, if you are still looking for more information, please contact us through one of
our preferred contact methods:

Email: [privacy@thlonline.com](mailto:privacy@thlonline.com)

[Back to Privacy Centre](https://www.thlonline.com/privacy)

# Hassle Free Returns

![Hassle free campervan hire returns](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Hassle-free-campervan-hire-returne.jpg)

All good things must come to an end… but not the Bunk Campers good service! We know it’s hard to say goodbye to your home on wheels, that’s why at Bunk Campers, we wanted to make things as easy as possible so we’ve added some hassle free return options that mean it has never been easier to return your motorhome.

Our guests regularly tell us they love our easy return options and couldn’t imagine their holiday finishing without them. We recommend you select one of these options at the time of booking, but you can also add them on any time, up to the day of pick up.

* * *

### ![Drop and go](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Drop-and-go.png)Drop and Go

**£195/ €235** _For the quickest and easiest way to return your motorhome, our Drop and Go service takes the hassle out of returning your vehicle._

_**Select our drop and go service to benefit from:**_

✔ _Priority key drop_

✔ _Return fuel tank empty (a full bottle will be provided at pick up)_

✔ _Return gas bottle empty (a full bottle will be provided at pick up)_

**Plus, _once you have completed your basic housekeeping, thl will take care of the final clean of your vehicle\*._**

✔ Tidying & removing bed linen & towels

✔ Packing kitchen boxes on return

✔ Last empty of rubbish

✔ Last empty of fridge/freezer

_\\* Excludes emptying of Toilet Cassette and Grey Water Tanks._

Current price is £195/€235.

* * *

### ![Easy Returns](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Easy-Returns-1.png)Easy Return

**£50** **/ €65**

**Don’t worry about the last minute clean and clear, we’ve got you covered.**

When guests select our Easy Returns service, Bunk Campers will take care of:

✔ Last empty of fridge/freezer

✔ Last empty of rubbish

✔ Tidying & removing bed linen & towels

✔ Packing kitchen boxes on return

_\\* Excludes emptying of Toilet Cassette and Grey Water Tanks._

And that’s it! Returning your campervan hire couldn’t be simpler. So, when you’re planning your next motorhome or campervan trip, remember to factor in a hassle-free return with Bunk Campers.

* * *

## How to book!

You can simply select the Easy Return option when you book using our online booking system or add the high road or value pack to you liability cover for Drop and Go. Alternatively, [email our customer service team](mailto:enquiries@bunkcampers.com) and we will be happy to assist. Don’t worry if you forget to add it, you can also add this right up to when you pick up the keys to your camper at the depot.

Find more [hireable extras here](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/before-you-arrive/hireable-extras/) to enhance your motorhome road trip or read some more of our [campervan holiday advice online](https://bunkcampers.com/en/holiday-advice/camping-guide/campervan-advice/).

## Ierland Toerisme exclusieve aanbieding – gratis beddengoed en kampeermeubilair

![Tourism Ireland Exclusive Offer](https://bunkcampers.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/causeway-coast2.jpg)

**Geniet dit jaar van een onvergetelijke vakantie in Noord-Ierland met deze exclusieve aanbieding van Bunk Campers en bespaar!**

Een campervakantie in Noord-Ierland biedt een veilige manier om het buitenleven te omarmen. Van de prachtige **Causeway kustroute** en de indrukwekkende geschiedenis van de **St Patrick’s Trail** tot de magie van de **Mourne Mountains** en het merengebied van **Fermanagh**…Noord-Ierland is een paradijs voor outdoor-liefhebbers.

Boek vanuit onze depots in [**Belfast**](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/belfast/) of **[Dublin](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervan-hire-locations/ireland/dublin/) e** n reis vol vertrouwen met onze garanties. U kunt de Bunk Camper kiezen die het beste bij u past uit [**ons brede aanbod van moderne voertuigen**](https://bunkcampers.com/book-with-confidence/). Van compacte campers tot grote campers voor families en vriendengroepen, we hebben voor elk wat wils.

### **Details van de aanbieding**

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Aanbieding:** | Gratis beddengoed en kampeermeubels bij de huur van een Bunk Camper |
| **Boekbaar**: | Tussen 1 februari en 15 april 2023 |
| **Reisperiode:** | 1 april 2023 t/m 30 september 2023 |
| **Exclusief volgende data:** | 20 juni t/m 29 augustus 2023 (ophalen en terugbrengen) |
| **Ophaaldepot:** | Dublin of Belfast |
| **Type voertuig**: | Alle types |
| **Hoe boek ik deze aanbieding?** | Voeg de promotiecode **CAMPERAANBOD** in bij boeking van een Bunk Camper met afhaallocatie Belfast. Voeg de promotiecode **CAMPERDEAL** in bij boeking van een Bunk Camper met afhaallocatie Dublin.<br>BELANGRIJK: om de beschikbaarheid te controleren of een boeking te maken buiten deze actieperiode, ga je terug naar de website en verwijder je de promotiecode.<br>Als u hulp nodig heeft kunt u contact opnemen met onze klantenservice via [enquiries@bunkcampers.com](mailto:enquiries@bunkcampers.com) of door te bellen naar +44 2890 813057 (maandag-vrijdag, 9.00-17.00 uur). |

### **Een campervakantie, op jouw manier**

### **Algemene voorwaarden:**

- De standaardvoorwaarden van Bunk Campers zijn van toepassing.
- Aanbieding strikt onder voorbehoud van beschikbaarheid.
- Er gelden minimale huurperiodes.
- Alleen van toepassing op nieuwe boekingen, kan niet worden gebruikt voor bestaande boekingen.
- Lang verblijf – kortingen zijn van toepassing.
- Deze aanbieding kan worden gebruikt in combinatie met andere speciale aanbiedingen.
- Kortingscode moet worden ingevoerd op het moment van boeking.
- Per boeking één actiecode geldig.
- Genoemde prijzen zijn in de valuta van het ophaaldepot.

## Campervan & Motorhome Hire For Less

# Mystery Vehicle Motorhome Hire

Choose from our **Mystery Vehicle 2, 4, 5 or 6** **berth** option and unlock savings of up to **20% OFF.**

When you select our Mystery Vehicles, you will **receive our choice** of campervan or motorhome **from either the Bunk Campers, Just go, or Apollo motorhome fleet.**

**Enjoy the exclusive opportunity to road trip in a vehicle from the UK & Ireland’s leading motorhome brands** and save on the overall rental price.

Simply choose the 2, 4, 5 or 6 berth Mystery Vehicle option and we will guarantee you will get a vehicle that sleeps your chosen berth. Our team will allocate you a vehicle prior to your collection at the depot. No matter what Mystery Vehicle you choose, you will receive a motorhome equipped with everything you need for the perfect road trip including **double or single beds, a gas hob, sink, dining area, shower, toilet, camper heating, electricity** and more!

After booking a Mystery Vehicle, enjoy the surprise of waiting until your collection day to discover what campervan or motorhome you will call your own.

If you’re looking for a more cost-effective way to enjoy a motorhome holiday then why not try our Mystery Vehicle options from the UK & Ireland’s leading motorhome brands Bunk Campers and Just go?

Book today, then sit back and relax until you meet your Mystery match.

_All rentals require a valid, full category B driver’s licence._

# Noleggio camper 4 posti letto a prezzi ridotti!

**Se siete flessibili nella scelta del veicolo, provate la nostra nuova opzione Saver 4 e godrete di uno dei nostri camper 4 posti letto a noleggio, a un prezzo inferiore.**

Selezionando l’opzione Saver 4, riceverete una scelta tra i seguenti camper: [Grande](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/grande/), [Europa](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/europa-apartment-style-4-person-motorhome-in-the-uk/) o [Vista Plus](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/4-person-motorhome-vistaplus/).  Godetevi l’attesa di uno di questi grandi camper e risparmiate sul costo del noleggio giornaliero!  Questo è un ottimo modo per godere di un grande camper della nostra selezione in modo più conveniente.

Con il Saver 4 avrete la garanzia di una capacità di dormire a 4 posti letto, con ogni opzione che offre spazio, comfort e grande spazio di stivaggio per un massimo di 4 persone.  La disposizione degli interni e dei posti letto varia da un modello all’altro, per cui non vedrete l’ora che la sorpresa si sveli il giorno del ritiro.  Gli ospiti che scelgono il veicolo Saver 4 non hanno la possibilità di scegliere il veicolo, che verrà assegnato il giorno del ritiro.

Tutti i nostri camper sono progettati con finiture moderne, il vostro camper a 4 posti letto sarà dotato di tutti i comfort di cui avete bisogno in viaggio: **letti matrimoniali o singoli, piano cottura a gas a 3 fuochi, lavello, zona pranzo, doccia, toilette, riscaldamento per camper ed elettricità.**

_Per tutti i noleggi è richiesta una patente di guida di categoria B valida e completa._

# 4 persoons camper huren voor minder!

**Als u flexibel bent in het kiezen van uw voertuig, probeer dan onze nieuwe Saver 4 optie en u zult genieten van een van onze coachbuilt 4 persoons motorhomes te huur, voor minder.**

Wanneer u de Saver 4 kiest, krijgt u onze keuze uit een van de volgende campers: [Grande](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/grande/), [Europa](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/europa-apartment-style-4-person-motorhome-in-the-uk/) of [Vista Plus](https://bunkcampers.com/en/campervans-for-hire/4-person-motorhome-vistaplus/).  Geniet van de voorpret van een van deze geweldige campers en bespaar op de dagelijkse huurkosten!  Dit is een geweldige manier om te genieten van een geweldige camper van onze selectie op een meer kosteneffectieve manier.

Met de Saver 4 bent u verzekerd van een slaapcapaciteit voor 4 personen, waarbij elke optie ruimte, comfort en veel opslagruimte biedt voor maximaal 4 personen.  De indeling van het interieur en de slaapindelingen verschillen per model, zodat u zich kunt verheugen op de verrassing die zich op de dag van afhalen zal openbaren.  Gasten die kiezen voor het Saver 4 voertuig hebben geen keuze van voertuig, het voertuig zal worden toegewezen op de dag van pick-up.

Al onze campers zijn ontworpen met een moderne afwerking, uw 4 persoons camper zal uitgerust zijn met alle voorzieningen die u onderweg nodig heeft: **tweepersoonsbedden of eenpersoonsbedden, 3 pits gaskookplaat, gootsteen, eethoek, douche, toilet, camperverwarming en elektriciteit.**

_Voor alle verhuur is een geldig, volledig rijbewijs categorie B vereist._
